scripts.text: Ha! Tsk,tsk! Is this some kind of joke?! Who'd manage the files like this? I'd never know!
scripts.translation: 哈！嘖嘖！這是在開玩笑嗎？！誰會這樣整理檔案？真叫人想不通！

scripts.text: Whew... I can't even stand looking at it! Oh just, give it to me!
scripts.translation: 呼......我都不忍心看！算了，拿給我吧！

scripts.text: Too bad I'm not in Schwarzwald. I could use our document restoring machine back at home... Ugh! Now I gotta do everything manually.
scripts.translation: 真可惜我不在修瓦爾茲巴魯德。要是在家，我還能用檔案修復機......唉！現在只能手動處理了。

scripts.text: Hmmm. It's completely soaked. I Should dry this thing first and iron these crumples. Then, I should restore the texts.
scripts.translation: 嗯，檔案完全溼透了。我得先把它晾乾、熨平褶皺，然後修復上面的文字。

scripts.text: I need some materials. You gotta help me on this. I need ^0000ff1 Fan, 1 Old Frying Pan, 1 Flame Stone, 1 Chinese Ink^000000.
scripts.translation: 我需要些材料，你得幫我。我要扇子1把^0000ff、破舊平底鍋1個、火靈原石1個、墨汁1^000000份。

scripts.text: Hey, hey... don't look at me like that. I know you're not delighted to do these things but think about it, what about me? Why should I restore this garbage?
scripts.translation: 嘿，別那樣看著我。我知道你不樂意做這些事，可想想我呢？我為什麼要修這堆垃圾？

scripts.text: Listen, sometimes, we've got to do things we don't like in order to get things accomplished.
scripts.translation: 聽著，有時為了把事情辦成，我們不得不做些自己不喜歡的事。

scripts.text: Just don't gorget that the file will be restored as fast as you prepare those things for me.
scripts.translation: 別忘了，材料準備得越快，我就能越快修好這份檔案。

scripts.text: I wonder if the preparation for the meeting's going ok.
scripts.translation: 不知道會議準備得怎麼樣了。

scripts.text: I heard Ryosen say that the file he requested from Hansenne is all ruined. I hope I dont get involved in that trouble.
scripts.translation: 我聽說良泉向漢森娜要的檔案全毀了。希望我不會被捲進這場麻煩。

scripts.text: I have no time to waste.
Could you please sit there and wait for me while I restore this file?
scripts.translation: 請坐在那裡等我修復這份檔案。

scripts.text: Hmmm. It's completely soaked. I Should dry this thing first and iron these crumples. Then, I should restore the texts.
scripts.translation: 嗯，檔案完全溼透了。我得先把它晾乾、熨平褶皺，然後修復上面的文字。

scripts.text: I need some materials. You gotta help me on this. I need ^0000ff1 Fan, 1 Old Frying Pan, 1 Flame Stone, 1 Chinese Ink^000000.
scripts.translation: 我需要些材料，你得幫我。我要扇子1把^0000ff、破舊平底鍋1個、火靈原石1個、墨汁1^000000份。

scripts.text: Just don't gorget that the file will be restored as fast as you prepare those things for me.
scripts.translation: 別忘了，材料準備得越快，我就能越快修好這份檔案。

scripts.text: The binding was too loose, so I re-arranged and bound the file all over again. This is how the true official document should look like. I really think they should learn how to arrange files.
scripts.translation: 裝訂太鬆了，所以我重新整理並裝訂了這份檔案。這才像正式檔案的樣子。我真覺得他們該學學怎麼整理檔案。

scripts.text: Please, deliver this file before it's too late. The meeting's gonna begin soon.
scripts.translation: 趁會議還沒開始，趕緊把這份檔案送過去。

scripts.text: I have to be extra careful with this kind of work, ok? Can't you sit quietly over there? Take a nap or something.
scripts.translation: 這種工作我得格外小心，明白嗎？你不能在那邊安靜坐會兒嗎？打個盹什麼的。

scripts.text: The binding was too loose, so I re-arranged and bound the file all over again. This is how the true official document should look like. I really think they should learn how to arrange files.
scripts.translation: 裝訂太鬆了，所以我重新整理並裝訂了這份檔案。這才像正式檔案的樣子。我真覺得他們該學學怎麼整理檔案。

scripts.text: Please, deliver this file before it's too late. The meeting's gonna begin soon.
scripts.translation: 趁會議還沒開始，趕緊把這份檔案送過去。

scripts.text: Well, finally... It's time for the meeting.
Like it or not... I should go in.
scripts.translation: 不管願不願意......我都得進去。

scripts.text: - Looks like he's thinking about something... very seriously. -
scripts.translation: - 看起來他正在非常認真地思考...... -

scripts.text: I just decided I can't stay like this.
scripts.translation: 我剛下定決心，不能再這樣下去了。

scripts.text: I couldn't confess the truth when Hansenne said he ruined the cake instead of me.
scripts.translation: 漢森娜替我承認是她弄壞了蛋糕，可我當時沒能說出真相。

scripts.text: I was so bewildered that I lost the chance to say anything... but... I was such a coward to admit that I was the one who caused the trouble.
scripts.translation: 我當時太慌亂，錯過了開口的機會......可是......我實在太懦弱，不敢承認是我惹的禍。

scripts.text: Oh, I'm so embarrassed to see him face to face. Or.. how about...
scripts.translation: 啊，和他面對面太尷尬了。要不......這樣如何......

scripts.text: Here, this is the Rune-Midgarts' report I took with me when everything went messy in the meeting room. Could you please give this to Ryosen?
scripts.translation: 這個，是會議室一片混亂時我帶走的盧恩·米德加爾特報告。能請你把它交給良泉嗎？

scripts.text: I'm sorry to ask you this but...
Could you? For this, I'll give you some Schwarzwald's Pineapple Jubilee.
scripts.translation: 能幫我這個忙嗎？作為回報，我給你一些修瓦爾茲巴魯德的菠蘿慶典。

scripts.text: Please give this report to Ryosen.
scripts.translation: 請把這份報告交給良泉。

scripts.text: Oh, I'm so embarrassed to see him face to face. Or.. how about...
scripts.translation: 啊，和他面對面太尷尬了。要不...這樣如何...

scripts.text: Here, this is the Rune-Midgarts' report I took with me when everything went messy in the meeting room. Could you please give this to Ryosen?
scripts.translation: 這個，是會議室一片混亂時我帶走的盧恩·米德加爾特報告。能請你把它交給良泉嗎？

scripts.text: I'm sorry to ask you this but...
If it weren't for you, we wouldn't be able to get along at all.
scripts.translation: 要不是你，我們根本沒法和好。

scripts.text: I don't know how to thank you!
scripts.translation: 真不知道該怎麼感謝你！

scripts.text: Have you ever seen something called, ^0000ffFur^000000 ?
I hear you can get it from the monsters called 'Tatacho' and 'Hillsrion' in the fields.
scripts.translation: 聽說野外的塔塔喬和希爾里昂會掉落這種東西。

scripts.text: Could you bring ^0000ffFur^000000 if you get some? I'm not asking it for free.
scripts.translation: 如果你找^0000ff到毛皮^000000，能帶些給我嗎？我不會白拿。

scripts.text: I'll give you my Pineapple Jubilee from Schwarzwald, if you bring me ^0000ff2 Furs^000000.
scripts.translation: 你給我2片毛皮的話，我就把修瓦爾茲巴魯德的^0000ff菠蘿慶典給^000000你。

scripts.text: I don't have any, right now.
Please give me some when you get some.
scripts.translation: 等你弄到了請給我一些。

scripts.text: You already have the Pineapple Jubilee from Schwarzwald!
scripts.translation: 你已經擁有修瓦魯茲巴魯德的菠蘿慶典了！

scripts.text: I think you should drin that thing fast. Otherwise, all the ice will melt and it'll taste like some kinda medicine!
scripts.translation: 我覺得你應該趁冰還沒化，趕緊把它喝掉。否則味道會變得像藥一樣！

scripts.text: Ah, are you sure you want to exchange?
Oh, so it's the thing called, Fur??
scripts.translation: 哦，就是那個叫毛皮的東西嗎？

scripts.text: Are you sure you want to exchange this for my Pineapple Jubilee?
scripts.translation: 你確定要用這個換我的菠蘿慶典嗎？

scripts.text: Come back any time if you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 如果你改變主意，隨時歡迎回來。

scripts.text: I always needed this because the weather here is colder then I expected. I'm sure this will keep me warm.
scripts.translation: 這裡比我預想的冷多了。我正好需要這個，穿上它肯定會暖和些。

scripts.text: Well, I don't think you have any Fur.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我想你應該沒有毛皮。

scripts.text: Please come back if you find any Fur.
scripts.translation: 如果你找到毛皮，請回來找我。

scripts.text: Don't walk around this area. It's restricted.
scripts.translation: 不要在這個區域走動。這裡是禁區。

scripts.text: Don't walk around this place without thinking.
scripts.translation: 不要不假思索地四處走動。

scripts.text: After all, it'll be you who'd be in trouble.
scripts.translation: 畢竟，惹上麻煩的會是你自己。

scripts.text: How come you've got so much to carry?
scripts.translation: 你怎麼帶了這麼多東西？

scripts.text: Are you perhaps on training or something?
scripts.translation: 難道是在進行什麼訓練嗎？
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。
嗯？什麼事把你帶到這裡來了？

scripts.text: Of course, your feet brought you here!?!
scripts.translation: 當然是你的腳把你帶來的咯！
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Hmm, Ryosen from Rune-Midgarts made it and... Hue from Schwarzwald agreed to sign it too?
scripts.translation: 嗯，盧恩·米德加爾特的良泉擬了這份邀請......而且修瓦爾茲巴魯德的休也同意簽字了？

scripts.text: Hmmm, that's not funny at all.
They're so boring. They always report to me after making all the decisions. No sense of humor... so stubborn and strict... They're totally not my style.
scripts.translation: 他們真無聊。總是先把所有事情決定好，再來通知我。一點幽默感都沒有......既固執又嚴肅......完全不是我的風格。

scripts.text: I should have a look at least.
You should take a rest, while I'm reading this. Oh, have some Poring Candy from Rune-Midgarts. It's terribly sour and sometimes salty. Funny taste, huh?
scripts.translation: 我讀的時候，你休息一下吧。哦，吃點盧恩·米德加爾特的波利糖。酸得要命，有時還帶點鹹味。味道很有趣，對吧？
嗯？你是盧恩·米德加爾特的人？

scripts.text: Then where's the person from Rude Midgard? Hahahahah, do you get my joke?
scripts.translation: 那“無禮·米德加爾特”的人呢？哈哈哈哈，懂我的笑話嗎？
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: - Hansenne drops some kind of liquid on the file document, and carefully looks at it. -
scripts.translation: - 漢森娜往檔案上滴了些液體，仔細檢視。 -

scripts.text: Meeting Schedule... on the Umpth day, from then-o'clock to later-o'clock
scripts.translation: 會議日程......某某日，從某某點到某某點。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Meeting Schedule, shmeating schedule... Beating Schedule!!
scripts.translation: 會議日程，什麼會議日程......打人日程！！
地點......盧恩·米德加爾特營地！

scripts.text: Are they camping in that place??
scripts.translation: 他們居然在那種地方紮營？？
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Objectives... to report on the researching progress of tracking Satan Morocc and of the Ash-Vacuum!
scripts.translation: 目標......彙報追蹤魔王夢羅克和研究阿什真空的進展！

scripts.text: Ash-Vacuum... what is that, a homemaker's device???
scripts.translation: .....那是什麼，家用吸塵器嗎？？？哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: ...and a very useless one which vacuums only ash!
scripts.translation: ......而且還是隻能吸灰燼的廢物吸塵器！
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Ehhhhh? And what's this? Having some time to get to know each other??? ...Pffthahahahaha...
scripts.translation: 誒？這是什麼？還有時間互相認識一下？？？......噗哈哈哈......
嘿，就在這上面籤個字吧。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: I can't help it! I can't stand this! What the heck!!! What do we have to know about each other???
scripts.translation: 我忍不住了！實在受不了！搞什麼啊！！！我們有什麼好互相瞭解的？？？
噗哈哈，這太不可思議了。

scripts.text: Ryosen's avery funny guy. Well, he wouldn't know how funny he is...
scripts.translation: 良泉真是個有趣的人。不過，他自己大概不知道自己有多有趣......

scripts.text: Haha, you should tell him that.

scripts.translation: 哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Ahhh, wait. I didn't finish reading it.

scripts.translation: 哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Hush! Please don't talk! We must pray now!
scripts.translation: 噓！別說話！我們現在要祈禱！

scripts.text: I got it, I got it. I should go to the meeting. Ryosen's really a funny guy, if you know what I mean.
scripts.translation: 知道了，知道了。我該去開會了。良泉真是個有趣的人，你懂我的意思吧。

scripts.text: Please, thank him for entertaining me. Haha, hahaha,
scripts.translation: 請替我謝謝他逗我開心。哈哈，哈哈哈，

scripts.text: I came to pick up the requested document.
You missed me? Don't expect a kiss!
scripts.translation: 你想我了？別指望我會親你哦！
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: A requested document? Did Ryosen send you?
scripts.translation: 要領取一份檔案？是良泉派你來的嗎？

scripts.text: Wait for me here. Now, where did I put it...?
scripts.translation: 你在這裡等我。我把它放哪兒了......？

scripts.text: I lost it. I think I might have dropped it into the river or something when I played treasure-hunting on a bridge!
scripts.translation: 我弄丟了。我想我在橋上玩尋寶遊戲時，可能把它掉進河裡了！

scripts.text: But you know, the funny thing is... I heard my parents picked me up on a bridge when I was a baby, and now I lost the document on a bridge! What a coincidence! Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation: 不過，有趣的是......我聽說自己還是嬰兒時，父母是在橋上把我撿回家的。現在我又在橋上弄丟了檔案！真巧啊！哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: It'll take time to make it all over. Although... Hmm... Should I go fishing and catch that thing~?
scripts.translation: 重新做一份得花些時間。不過......嗯......要不要去釣魚，把那份檔案撈上來～？

scripts.text: Those pussycats on the South-West can teach us fishing, you know.
scripts.translation: 西南邊那些貓咪會教我們釣魚哦。

scripts.text: Maybe we can catch that document with a fishing rod if we're lucky!
scripts.translation: 也許運氣好的話，能用魚竿把檔案釣上來！

scripts.text: I lost it. I think I might have dropped it into the river or something when I played treasure-hunting on a bridge!
scripts.translation: 我弄丟了。我想我可能在橋上玩尋寶遊戲的時候，不小心把它掉進河裡了！

scripts.text: But you know, the funny thing is... I heard my parents picked me up on a bridge when I was a baby, and now I lost the document on a bridge! What a coincidence! Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation: 不過你知道嗎，有趣的是......我聽說我小時候是被父母在橋上撿到的，而現在我又在橋上弄丟了檔案！真巧啊！哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: It'll take time to make it all over. Although... Hmm... Should I go fishing and catch that thing~?
scripts.translation: 重新做一份得花些時間。不過......嗯......要不要去釣魚，把那份檔案撈上來～？

scripts.text: Those pussycats on the South-West can teach us fishing, you know.
scripts.translation: 你知道的，西南邊那些貓咪會教我們釣魚。

scripts.text: Mmmm, I'm sure this is the one I made, just by looking at this overall shape.
scripts.translation: 嗯，光看整體形狀，我就確定這是我做的那份。

scripts.text: Hmmmmm, but then... I'm afraid Ryosen would explode when he sees this! Boom!!!
scripts.translation: 嗯......不過......我怕良泉看到這份檔案會氣炸！轟！！！

scripts.text: Schwarzwald people have some talent in restoring things like this... Why don't you ask Hue to restore this?
scripts.translation: 修瓦爾茲巴魯德的人很擅長修復這種東西......你為什麼不請休幫忙？

scripts.text: He'd scream so hard and the windows might break. But he'll do it.
scripts.translation: 他肯定會尖叫到把窗戶震碎。不過他會幫忙的。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: I lost it. I think I might have dropped it into the river or something when I played treasure-hunting on a bridge!
scripts.translation: 我弄丟了。我想我可能在橋上玩尋寶遊戲的時候，不小心把它掉進河裡了！

scripts.text: But you know, the funny thing is... I heard my parents picked me up on a bridge when I was a baby, and now I lost the document on a bridge! What a coincidence! Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation: 不過你知道嗎，有趣的是......我聽說我小時候是被父母在橋上撿到的，而現在我又在橋上弄丟了檔案！真巧啊！哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: It'll take time to make it all over. Although... Hmm... Should I go fishing and catch that thing~?
scripts.translation: 重新做一份得花些時間。不過......嗯......要不要去釣魚，把那份檔案撈上來～？

scripts.text: Those pussycats on the South-West can teach us fishing, you know.
scripts.translation: 你知道的，西南邊那些貓咪會教我們釣魚。

scripts.text: Hmmmmm, it's all screwed up. I'm afraid Ryosen would explode when he sees this! Boom!!!
scripts.translation: 嗯，全都亂套了。我怕良泉看到後會氣炸！轟！！！

scripts.text: Schwarzwald people have some talent in restoring things like this... Why don't you ask Hue to restore this?
scripts.translation: 修瓦爾茲巴魯德的人擅長修復這類東西......你為什麼不請休來修復一下呢？

scripts.text: He'd scream so hard and the windows might break. But he'll do it.
scripts.translation: 他肯定會尖叫得震碎窗戶。不過他還是會幫忙的。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: I don't wanna get in trouble. I should hurry up.
scripts.translation: 我可不想惹上麻煩，得趕緊走了。

scripts.text: That friend of yours never gets my jokes... My sense of humor is... just... out of his league!! Haha, hahaha, hahahahahahahahaha.
scripts.translation: 你那位朋友根本聽不懂我的笑話......我的幽默感......簡直......高他好幾個等級！！哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Hehhhhh??? What are you talking about? If you wanna blame me for anything, tell me the reason first~
scripts.translation: 嘿？？？你在說什麼？要怪我也得先說清楚理由嘛～
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: I know you're not the one who ruined the cake. I saw it. It was Hue! I saw him clearly when he pressed his hand on the cake when the Thief Bug came out.
scripts.translation: 我知道毀掉蛋糕的不是你。我親眼看見了，是休！盜蟲出現時，我清楚看到他把手按在了蛋糕上。

scripts.text: Well... Who cares who did it?
scripts.translation: 嗯......誰做的又有什麼關係？

scripts.text: It was just a mistake. Nothing's gonna change even if we find out who did it. The cake is still ruined, isn't it?
scripts.translation: 只是個意外。就算查出是誰做的，也改變不了什麼。蛋糕還是毀了，不是嗎？

scripts.text: Hmmmmm... or... I don't know. Maybe I'm thanlful that he restored my garbage looking file... ?
scripts.translation: 嗯......或者......我也不知道。也許我該感謝他修好了我那份破爛檔案......？

scripts.text: But... You were blamed for it.
Aren't you feeling bad? It's unfair!
scripts.translation: 你不覺得難過嗎？這不公平！

scripts.text: Ryosen could be very rhough when he gets freaked out, but he will forget about all that soon...
scripts.translation: 良泉受驚時說話可能會很衝，不過他很快就會忘掉這件事......
我明白。他當時只是很難過。

scripts.text: You see, he brought that cake for all of us in there. He wouldn't normally do that, but I guess he wanted to be nice. But then, poof~ the cake was ruined.
scripts.translation: 你看，他是特意帶蛋糕來和大家分享的。他平時不會這麼做，我想他只是想對大家好一點。結果，噗～蛋糕就毀了。

scripts.text: He must've been so upset that we all couldn't share that cake. Isn't it kinda cute?
scripts.translation: 蛋糕沒能和大家一起分享，他一定很難過。是不是有點可愛？
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Well, it's nothing big. Don't you think?
scripts.translation: 嗯，沒什麼大不了的。你不覺得嗎？

scripts.text: He'll be ok soon. He'll get to thinking that it wasn't actually a big deal.
scripts.translation: 他很快就會沒事的，會想明白其實沒什麼大不了的。

scripts.text: But the thing is that... the relationship between Ryosen and Hue isn't looking good at all.
scripts.translation: 不過......良泉和休的關係一直不太好。

scripts.text: Why don't you help them get along with each other?
Sorry for asking these things of you. And... here's Arunageltz's Desert Sandwich. It's nothing special but... tastes pretty good.
scripts.translation: 抱歉讓你幫忙處理這些。還有......這是阿魯納菲茲的沙漠三明治。雖然普通......但味道還不錯。

scripts.text: Thank you for doing me a favor.

scripts.translation: 哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: The relationship between Ryosen and Hue isn't looking good at all.
scripts.translation: 良泉和休的關係一直不太好。

scripts.text: Why don't you help them get along with each other?
I heard about you from the Official. Thank you so much for helping us.
scripts.translation: 我從那位官員那裡聽說了你的事。非常感謝你幫我們。

scripts.text: Anyways.. I wonder if you have seen a ^0000ffPeaked Hat^000000. I heard the monster, 'Tatacho' has that hat.
scripts.translation: 話說回來......你^0000ff見過尖頂帽^000000嗎？聽說怪物“塔塔喬”有一頂。

scripts.text: Can you give me a ^0000ffPeaked Hat^000000 if you have any? I'm not asking for free.
scripts.translation: 如果你有的^0000ff話，能給我^000000一頂尖頂帽嗎？我不會白拿。

scripts.text: For ^0000ff2 Peaked Hats^000000, I'll give you my special dessert!
scripts.translation: 給^0000ff我2頂尖頂帽，^000000作為交換我會把特製甜點給你。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Oh, it loos like you already have the Arunafeltz's Desert Sandwich.
scripts.translation: 哦，看起來你已經有阿魯納菲茲的沙漠三明治了。

scripts.text: You should eat that up before it gets rotten. Maybe it's gone bad already.
scripts.translation: 趁它還沒壞，趕緊吃掉吧。說不定已經變質了。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Are you sure you want to give these to me?
scripts.translation: 你確定要把它們給我嗎？

scripts.text: No way. Yes way. This way. That way.
scripts.translation: 不行？行啊。這樣吧，那樣吧。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。
當前狀態：未在招募。已招募兼職人員名。你想做什麼？

scripts.text: What do you want to do?
This is where we keep creatures
scripts.translation: 這裡存放著我們在阿什真空捕獲的生物。
學者和專家負責研究它們。

scripts.text: I'm here to tame and breed
scripts.translation: 我則負責馴服和繁殖危
我希望能把它們當作寵物帶在身邊。
這種動物在大陸上可找不到，

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I don't need any assistance right now.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我現在不需要幫忙。

scripts.text: I'll make an official anouncement if I need help.
scripts.translation: 如果需要，我會發布正式公告。
你的工作很簡單：收集動物飼料，

scripts.text: I'm fresh out, and I'll need to restock very soon.
scripts.translation: 我剛好用完了，很快就得補充。

scripts.text: You can find them from Tatachoes in the fields.
scripts.translation: 田野裡的塔塔喬會掉落這些魚。

scripts.text: I don't know where they've caught the fish.
scripts.translation: 我也不知道它們是從哪裡抓到魚的。

scripts.text: Please bring me feed for Tatachoes: ^4d4dff50 Fresh Fish^000000.
scripts.translation: 請帶來塔塔喬的飼料：^4d4dff新鮮魚50^000000條。
科爾努斯的飼料剛好用完了。
學者們認為這些傢伙屬於貓科。

scripts.text: I was going to try some
scripts.translation: 我本來就想給希爾里昂試試新飼料。

scripts.text: but I don't know if they
I want to try Meat this time.
I really hope they'll like the Meat.
Oh, I always wanted to put something warm on the floor for my creatures.
scripts.translation: 哦，我一直想在籠子地上鋪些暖和的東西給這些生物。

scripts.text: I was thinking of using fur.
I can also use fur to cover the cage during rainy days, you know?
scripts.translation: 下雨天還可以拿毛皮蓋住籠子，你說呢？

scripts.text: Can you please bring me ^4d4dff30 scraps of fur^000000?
scripts.translation: 能請你帶來毛^4d4dff皮碎片30片^000000嗎？

scripts.text: I think the fur of Tatachoes and Hillsrions will be perfect.
scripts.translation: 塔塔喬和希爾里昂的毛皮應該正合適。

scripts.text: Of course, I'm not going to use them for the cages with the Tatachoes and Hillsrions.
scripts.translation: 當然，我不會把它們用在塔塔喬和希爾里昂的籠子裡。

scripts.text: Those furs will be for the Cornuses.
scripts.translation: 那些毛皮是給科爾努斯用的。

scripts.text: What are you still doing here? Go, go speak to Abidal.

scripts.translation: 不得不說，我相當欣賞你。

scripts.text: As you know by now, I have to send out an expedition report to the national leaders of the Midgard continent, and I need someone that I can trust.
scripts.translation: 想必你也知道，我必須向米德加爾特大陸各國的領導人提交遠征報告，而我需要一個值得信任的人。

scripts.text: I'd go if I could, but my duty is to command, and my instructor over there is too dense. He'll embarrass me by acting stupid in front of the national leaders.
scripts.translation: 要是能去，我當然想親自去，但我的職責是指揮。那邊的指導員又太遲鈍，在各國領導人面前做蠢事會讓我丟臉。
拜託了，老闆......啊不，指揮官！

scripts.text: Hmm... Anyways, this is not a difficult mission. All you have to do is deliver this expedition report to officials of three countries of Midgard. Simple right?
scripts.translation: 嗯......總之，這任務不難。你只要把遠征報告送給米德加爾特三國的官員就行了。很簡單吧？

scripts.text: The officials are ^0000FFMinister Laur^000000 of the Rune-Midgarts' Kingdom, ^0000FFPriest Nuria^000000 of Arunafeltz, and ^0000FFGerhart^000000 of the Schwatzvalt Republic.
scripts.translation: 這些官員分別^0000FF是：盧恩·米^000000德加爾特王國的勞爾大臣、^0000FF阿魯納菲茲^000000的努莉亞祭司，以及^0000FF修瓦爾茲^000000巴魯德共和國的格哈特。

scripts.text: A messenger, who will inform the official of your arrival, is waiting for you at the time-space gap to Midgard. You'd better find him before you leave.
scripts.translation: 在通往米德加爾特的次元裂縫處，有一位信使在等你，他會通知官員你的到來。你最好在出發前找到他。

scripts.text: Since the officials are busy attending to national matters, they won't meet you unless they're informed of your arrival beforehand. I doubt those pretentious guys would even want to see me.
scripts.translation: 官員們正忙於處理國家事務，必須提前通知他們，他們才會見你。我懷疑那些自命不凡的傢伙甚至都不願意見我。

scripts.text: Travel safely, adventurer, and come back in one piece, alright?
scripts.translation: 旅途平安，冒險者，記得要平安回來，好嗎？

scripts.text: Haven't you left yet? It's hard to make ends meet, isn't it?
scripts.translation: 你還沒出發嗎？生活不容易，對吧？

scripts.text: I mean, if you want to be paid, you'll have to work. Do you still not understand? I'm saying that you better proceed with your mission.
scripts.translation: 我是說，想拿報酬就得幹活。你還沒明白嗎？趕緊去執行任務吧。

scripts.text: Alright, alright. I know why you've come to see me.
scripts.translation: 好了好了。我知道你為什麼來見我了。

scripts.text: They haven't gotten the report yet. We should send out soldiers...
scripts.translation: 他們還沒收到報告。我們應該派些士兵去......

scripts.text: That's not why I'm concerned. The problem is that the assignee failed to complete the mission and lost the report.
scripts.translation: 我擔心的不是這個。問題是，負責的人沒能完成任務，還把報告弄丟了。

scripts.text: Anyways... It's alright. You don't have to feel bad. I understand you didn't mean it this way.
scripts.translation: 總之......沒關係。你不用難過，我知道你不是故意的。

scripts.text: Commander, who might have done this? I will destroy him myself.
scripts.translation: 指揮官，是誰幹的？我要親手收拾他。

scripts.text: Don't impose. Our troops aren't just from one nation, they are from thre different countries, and are here to pursue their country's own interest.
scripts.translation: 別衝動。我們的部隊來自三個不同的國家，他們各自代表本國的利益。

scripts.text: Hard to say... who is behind this. If I had to guess, either side could be behind this...
scripts.translation: 很難說......幕後黑手是誰。如果非要猜，任何一方都有可能......

scripts.text: *Spit* This is why I don't trust politicians. Abidal, resolving this incident is your top priority.
scripts.translation: *啐* 這就是我不信任政客的原因。阿比達爾，解決這次事件是你的首要任務。

scripts.text: Igrid, evaluate the security of this camp and discipline among the soldiers.
scripts.translation: 伊格麗德，評估一下營地的安全狀況和士兵紀律。

scripts.text: Now it's your turn... Abidal disposed reports from various departments after he used them to compile the expedition report.
scripts.translation: 現在輪到你了......阿比達爾編寫遠征報告書後，就處理掉了各部門提交的報告。

scripts.text: We take the security of our documents seriously. So... There are no extra copies of the expedition report.
scripts.translation: 我們非常重視檔案安全。所以......遠征報告書沒有副本。

scripts.text: I still remember at least 30% of the document. I might be able to rewrite another...
scripts.translation: 我至少還記得那份檔案30%的內容。也許我能重新寫一份......

scripts.text: I need it to be perfect. What can we do with only 30%?
scripts.translation: 我需要一份完整的報告。只有30%的內容有什麼用？

scripts.text: Hey, you must find the report. If you bring as may pages of the report as you can, then Abidal will use them to fill missing parts.
scripts.translation: 嘿，你一定要找到那份報告。儘可能多地找回報告頁，阿比達爾會用它們補上缺失部分。

scripts.text: Some of them might have be consumed by monsters, or have found their way to the sea, but I don't care. You'll find them at all costs, and that's my order.
scripts.translation: 有些頁可能被魔物吃了，也可能掉進海里，但我不管。你必須不惜一切代價找回來，這是命令。

scripts.text: I hope you'll do your best. You need to finish what you've started. We'll do our best to help you. Am I right, guys? Abidal? Igrid?
scripts.translation: 我希望你盡力而為。既然開始了，就要做完。我們會盡力協助你。對吧，大家？阿比達爾？伊格麗德？

scripts.text: Now, search everywhere for the pages of that report. Staff Officer Abidal will bind them into the full report for you.
scripts.translation: 好了，到處去找那份報告書的頁面吧。參謀阿比達爾會把它們裝訂成完整的報告書。

scripts.text: Ah, and... I've received a report that you tried to hand out the report to our enemy when the situation happened.
scripts.translation: 啊，還有......我收到報告說，事發時你曾試圖把報告書交給敵人。

scripts.text: Hahaha! You're smart, my friend. Of course, I don't like smart soldiers.
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈！你很聰明，我的朋友。不過我可不喜歡太聰明計程車兵。

scripts.text: Let me tell you this: I can care less about justice or righteousness, but loyalty and faithfulness are very important. Keep that in mind for your own good, alright?
scripts.translation: 告訴你吧，我不在乎什麼正義公道，但忠誠和守信非常重要。記住這點，對你有好處，明白嗎？

scripts.text: I wish you good luck in finding the pages. Try to clean any smudges off them when you find them, alright?
scripts.translation: 祝你順利找到報告頁。找到後，記得把上面的汙漬擦掉，好嗎？

scripts.text: Alright, alright. I know why you've come to see me.
scripts.translation: 好了好了。我知道你為什麼來見我了。

scripts.text: They haven't gotten the report yet. We should send out soldiers...
scripts.translation: 他們還沒收到報告。我們應該派士兵去......

scripts.text: That's not why I'm concerned. The problem is that the assignee failed to complete the mission and lost the report.
scripts.translation: 我擔心的不是這個。問題是，負責的人沒能完成任務，並且丟失了報告書。

scripts.text: Anyways... It's alright. You don't have to feel bad. I understand you didn't mean it this way.
scripts.translation: 總之......沒關係。你不用感到難過，我知道你不是故意的。

scripts.text: Commander, I'll go find those evil scoundrels...
scripts.translation: 指揮官，我去找那些卑鄙小人......

scripts.text: Don't impose. Our troops aren't just from one nation, they are from thre different countries, and are here to pursue their country's own interest.
scripts.translation: 別衝動。我們的部隊來自三個不同的國家，他們各自代表本國的利益。

scripts.text: I wonder who's behind this. Frankly, I must say that every country is a suspect.
scripts.translation: 不知道幕後黑手是誰。老實說，每個國家都有嫌疑。

scripts.text: *Spit* This is why I don't trust politicians. Abidal, resolving this incident is your top priority.
scripts.translation: *啐* 這就是我不信任政客的原因。阿比達爾，解決這次事件是你的首要任務。

scripts.text: Igrid, evaluate the security of this camp and discipline among the soldiers.
scripts.translation: 伊格麗德，評估一下這個營地的安全狀況以及士兵們的紀律。

scripts.text: Now it's your turn... Abidal disposed reports from various departments after he used them to compile the expedition report.
scripts.translation: 現在輪到你了......阿比達爾編寫遠征報告時，用完各部門的報告就把它們處理掉了。

scripts.text: We take the security of our documents seriously. So... There are no extra copies of the expedition report.
scripts.translation: 我們非常重視檔案安全。所以......遠征隊報告書沒有副本。

scripts.text: I still remember at least 30% of the document. I might be able to rewrite another...
scripts.translation: 我至少還記得那份檔案30%的內容。也許我能重新寫一份......

scripts.text: I need it to be perfect. What can we do with only 30%?
scripts.translation: 我需要它完美無缺。只有30%的內容有什麼用？

scripts.text: Hey, you must find the report. If you bring as may pages of the report as you can, then Abidal will use them to fill missing parts.
scripts.translation: 嘿，你必須找到那份報告。儘可能多地找回報告頁，阿比達爾會用它們補上缺失的部分。

scripts.text: Some of them might have be consumed by monsters, or have found their way to the sea, but I don't care. You'll find them at all costs, and that's my order.
scripts.translation: 有些頁可能被魔物吃了，也可能掉進海里，但我不管。你必須不惜一切代價找回來，這是命令。

scripts.text: I hope you'll do your best. You need to finish what you've started. We'll do our best to help you. Am I right, guys? Abidal? Igrid?
scripts.translation: 我希望你盡力而為。既然開始了，就要做完。我們會盡力協助你。對吧，大家？阿比達爾？伊格麗德？

scripts.text: Now, search everywhere for the pages of that report. Staff Officer Abidal will bind them into the full report for you.
scripts.translation: 好了，到處去找那份報告書的頁面吧。參謀阿比達爾會把它們裝訂成完整的報告書。

scripts.text: Ah, and... I've received a report that you fought hard against the enemy to protect the report from them.
scripts.translation: 啊，還有......我收到報告說，你為了保護報告書不落入敵人手中而奮力戰鬥。

scripts.text: Hahaha, you're fearless and I can make good use of a soldier like you at any time of the day.
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈，你真是無所畏懼。像你這樣計程車兵，隨時都能派上用場。

scripts.text: Let me tell you this, loyalty and faithfulness are very, very important. They may cause you hardship sometimes, but those qualities will guarantee you the last laugh.
scripts.translation: 讓我告訴你，忠誠和守信非常、非常重要。它們有時會讓你吃苦，但最終會讓你笑到最後。

scripts.text: I wish you good luck in finding the pages. Try to clean any smudges off them when you find them, alright?
scripts.translation: 祝你順利找到報告頁。找到後，記得把上面的汙漬擦掉，好嗎？

scripts.text: Talk to my staff officer until you're finisehd finding the pages of the lost report. Right now, I'm swarmed with work.
scripts.translation: 找到遺失報告的所有頁面之前，先去找參謀阿比達爾。我現在忙得不可開交。

scripts.text: I'm sure you'll easily find those if you keep your eyes open. I must warn you about the monsters around this area though. Who knows? They might love the taste of paper.
scripts.translation: 只要你留心觀察，應該很容易找到。不過我要提醒你，這一帶有很多魔物。誰知道呢？它們可能很喜歡紙張的味道。

scripts.text: How have you been doing? I've heard Igrid has personally send out his soldiers to support you guys.
scripts.translation: 最近怎麼樣？聽說伊格麗德親自派了士兵來支援你們。

scripts.text: While searching for the report, look around and meet our soldiers.
scripts.translation: 尋找報告時，四處看看，認識一下我們計程車兵吧。

scripts.text: They've been sent to help you and Abidal. Ask their help if you think you need it.
scripts.translation: 他們是來協助你和阿比達爾的。如果你覺得需要幫助，儘管找他們。

scripts.text: So, the report has been restored successfully?
scripts.translation: 那麼，報告已經成功復原了嗎？

scripts.text: This was finished more quickly than I thought. Let me see...
scripts.translation: 這比我預想的快。讓我看看......

scripts.text: It looks alright. I don't have to read this thoroughly because I trust Abidal.
scripts.translation: 看起來沒問題。我相信阿比達爾，不必逐字逐句地檢查。

scripts.text: Now, let's go back to your original mission. I'd like you to deliver this to the national leaders of the three countries of Midgard.
scripts.translation: 好了，回到你最初的任務。我希望你把這份報告送給米德加爾特三國的領導人。

scripts.text: Dont worry too much, my friend.
I've arranged troops in the time-space gap to protect the report.
scripts.translation: 我已經在次元裂縫安排了部隊保護報告。

scripts.text: Of course, you can't see them because they're undercover soldiers under my direct command. Hahaha!
scripts.translation: 當然，你看不見他們，因為他們是直接聽命於我的秘密部隊。哈哈哈！

scripts.text: Let me remind you again. The officials are these three people: ^0000FFMinister Laur^000000 of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, ^0000FFPriest Nuria^000000 of Arunafeltz and ^0000FFGerhart^000000 of the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation: 再提醒你一次，收件官員是這三位：盧恩^0000FF·米德加爾^000000特王國的勞爾大臣、阿魯^0000FF納菲茲的努莉^000000亞祭司，以及修^0000FF瓦爾茲巴^000000魯德共和國的格哈特。

scripts.text: Make sure to deliver the report to them without fail. Come back in one piece, alright?
scripts.translation: 務必把報告送到他們手中。平安歸來，好嗎？

scripts.text: Let me remind you again. The officials are these three people: ^0000FFMinister Laur^000000 of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, ^0000FFPriest Nuria^000000 of Arunafeltz and ^0000FFGerhart^000000 of the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation: 再提醒你一次，官員是這三位：盧恩·^0000FF米德加茲王^000000國的勞爾大臣、阿魯納^0000FF菲茲的努莉亞^000000祭司，以及修瓦^0000FF魯茲巴^000000魯德共和國的格哈特。

scripts.text: Make sure to deliver the report to them without fail. Come back in one piece, alright?
scripts.translation: 務必確保將報告送達他們手中。平安歸來，好嗎？

scripts.text: Is something wrong? Alright, we'll write another report for you.
scripts.translation: 出什麼事了嗎？好吧，我們會再給你寫一份報告。

scripts.text: Let me remind you again. The officials are these three people: ^0000FFMinister Laur^000000 of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, ^0000FFPriest Nuria^000000 of Arunafeltz and ^0000FFGerhart^000000 of the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation: 再提醒你一次，官員是這三位：盧恩·^0000FF米德加茲王^000000國的勞爾大臣、阿魯納^0000FF菲茲的努莉亞^000000祭司，以及修瓦^0000FF魯茲巴^000000魯德共和國的格哈特。

scripts.text: Make sure to deliver the report to them without fail. Come back in one piece, alright?
scripts.translation: 務必確保將報告送達他們手中。平安歸來，好嗎？

scripts.text: Let me remind you again. The officials are these three people: ^0000FFMinister Laur^000000 of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, ^0000FFPriest Nuria^000000 of Arunafeltz and ^0000FFGerhart^000000 of the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation: 再提醒你一次，官員是這三位：盧恩·^0000FF米德加茲王^000000國的勞爾大臣、阿魯納^0000FF菲茲的努莉亞^000000祭司，以及修瓦^0000FF魯茲巴^000000魯德共和國的格哈特。

scripts.text: Make sure to deliver the report to them without fail. Come back in one piece, alright?
scripts.translation: 務必確保將報告送達他們手中。平安歸來，好嗎？

scripts.text: Oh, how was your trip? Hey, you look better than you did when you left. Did you drop by your hometown and enjoy great food or something?
scripts.translation: 哦，旅途如何？嘿，你看起來比出發時氣色好多了。難道你順路回了趟家鄉，吃了頓好飯？

scripts.text: So tell me, did you bring the report to all three national leaders? Good job.
scripts.translation: 那麼告訴我，你把報告交給三位國家領導人了嗎？幹得好。

scripts.text: I understand there were some unforeseen obstacles we didn't anticipate since we thought this mission was pretty trivial, but you still did your best.
scripts.translation: 我聽說途中遇到了一些我們沒預料到的阻礙。我們原以為任務很簡單，但你還是盡力完成了。

scripts.text: I must warn you, however, this is not the end of these strange events. You're involved in this situation so deeply that you can't get out of it. Hahaha!
scripts.translation: 不過我得提醒你，這些怪事還沒結束。你已經深陷其中，無法脫身。哈哈哈！

scripts.text: Don't worry. I'm not here to fool around. Isn't that right?
scripts.translation: 別擔心，我不是在開玩笑。對吧？

scripts.text: Yes, sir. We can't let the same thing happen again.
scripts.translation: 是的，長官。我們不能讓同樣的事情再次發生。

scripts.text: I shall find out who's behind this, and destroy him.
scripts.translation: 我會查明幕後黑手，並將他消滅。

scripts.text: So... I was hoping that you'll come back and help us once we figure out who's behind this. Will you?
scripts.translation: 那麼......等我們查明幕後黑手後，希望你能回來幫忙。你願意嗎？

scripts.text: And please take this small reward.
scripts.translation: 請收下這份小小的謝禮。

scripts.text: Thank you for your help so far.
scripts.translation: 感謝你一直以來的幫助。

scripts.text: Then I'll see you next time. Keep yourself in one piece, alright?
scripts.translation: 那我們下次再見。保重，別受傷了，好嗎？

scripts.text: Hey, how have you been? It's too early to say that we've figured out who's the mastermind.
scripts.translation: 嘿，最近怎麼樣？現在就說我們已經查明幕後黑手還為時過早。

scripts.text: Please be patient, I'll contact you when the time is right.
scripts.translation: 請耐心等待，時機成熟時我會聯絡你。

scripts.text: Wait, have you explored this area yet? I mean the wide tundra and fields around the camp.
scripts.translation: 等等，你探索過這片區域了嗎？我是說營地周圍廣闊的苔原和原野。

scripts.text: There are many fun things outside. If you are an adventurer, go explore for yourself. Come back after you've explored the areas around the camp.
scripts.translation: 外面有很多有趣的東西。既然你是冒險者，就自己去探索一下吧。探索完營地周圍的區域後再回來。

scripts.text: Ah, it's you again. So, are you accustomed to this area now?
scripts.translation: 啊，又是你。你現在習慣這片區域了嗎？

scripts.text: What brings you here again? You seem to have something to say to me.
scripts.translation: 你這次來有什麼事？看起來你似乎有話想對我說。

scripts.text: I just want to say hello.
I found a weird portal below the mine cave.
scripts.translation: 我在礦洞下方發現了一個奇怪的入口。

scripts.text: Please be patient. I'll contact you when the time is right.
scripts.translation: 請耐心等待，時機成熟時我會聯絡你。

scripts.text: What portal? I've never heard about it.
scripts.translation: 什麼入口？我從沒聽說過。

scripts.text: That place must be where both races fight against each other. It might be dangerous there.
scripts.translation: 那裡應該是兩個種族交戰的地方，可能很危險。

scripts.text: I have no idea of what it is like. It is not in my field of expertise.
scripts.translation: 我不瞭解那裡的情況，那不在我的專業範圍內。

scripts.text: There is someone here who can help you. He is a historian from Rune-Midgarts. He may be aware of some relics or something that could help.
scripts.translation: 這裡有個人能幫你。他是來自盧恩·米德加爾特的歷史學家，可能瞭解一些遺蹟或其他有用的資訊。

scripts.text: Find the historian and see if he has any useful information for you.
scripts.translation: 去找那位歷史學家，看看他有沒有什麼有用的資訊。

scripts.text: He's at his post, you can't find him?
scripts.translation: 他就在自己的崗位上，你找不到他嗎？

scripts.text: His name is Magniffer... look for him.. he's somewhere around here...
scripts.translation: 他叫馬格尼弗......去找找看......應該就在附近......

scripts.text: Did you talk with the scholar? Thesedays, I haven't seen him for a while.
scripts.translation: 你和那位學者談過了嗎？最近這段時間，我沒怎麼見到他。

scripts.text: That's because you don't like talking to him.
scripts.translation: 那是因為你不喜歡跟他說話。

scripts.text: Hey, don't judge me like that...the problem is only that I can't see him often.
scripts.translation: 嘿，別那樣說我......我只是沒怎麼見到他而已。

scripts.text: Whatever. Did something happen because he showed up to me? Tell me more.
scripts.translation: 算了。他來找我之後發生了什麼？詳細說說。

scripts.text: So, that's why that happened like that... It's so complicated...
scripts.translation: 原來事情是這樣發生的......真複雜......

scripts.text: And you guys...you just take a task that you start up at first.
scripts.translation: 還有你們......你們只是繼續處理一開始接下的任務。

scripts.text: You sent him to Doctor Magnifer first....
scripts.translation: 你一開始讓他去找馬格尼弗博士......

scripts.text: I just thought that he needed someone to talk to.
scripts.translation: 我只是覺得他需要有人傾訴。

scripts.text: Hmm... for example, you want to investigate a cave that you found, but you got on the Laphine and Sapha's nerves. right?
scripts.translation: 嗯......比如，你想調查發現的洞穴，卻惹惱了拉斐族和薩法族，對吧？

scripts.text: And that two guys pay attention and stay quiet, but they are doing it for themselves..
scripts.translation: 那兩個人雖然留意著情況，卻保持沉默，不過他們各有自己的打算......

scripts.text: The most important thing is that this place is the ground that the Yggdrasilberry takes root acording to Magnifer.
scripts.translation: 最重要的是，根據馬格尼弗的說法，這裡是天地樹果實紮根之地。

scripts.text: Abidal, do you have anything to say about this?
scripts.translation: 阿比達爾，你對此有什麼看法？

scripts.text: Our object is to make contact with one tribe and investgate this world and how adaptable it can be.
scripts.translation: 我們的目標是與一個部落建立聯絡，並調查這個世界以及它是否適合我們。

scripts.text: Actually, we don't have to make this situation bigger than it already is.
scripts.translation: 實際上，我們沒必要讓局勢變得更加複雜。

scripts.text: Yeah right. I don't want to extend this thing anymore...
scripts.translation: 沒錯。我也不想把事情鬧得更大......

scripts.text: But the two tribes have remained neutral towards us up until now.
scripts.translation: 不過到目前為止，這兩個部落對我們一直持中立態度。

scripts.text: We don't really know what attitude they have towards us.
scripts.translation: 我們並不清楚他們對我們到底持什麼態度。

scripts.text: Yeah.. that makes sense... If they made a general attack, we would probably fail.
scripts.translation: 嗯......有道理......如果他們發動全面進攻，我們恐怕會撐不住。

scripts.text: We should map out a strategy. There is a method that uses Laphine and Sapha's together.
scripts.translation: 我們應該制定一個策略，可以同時利用拉斐族和薩法族。

scripts.text: We send this guy to one of the tribes and ask for cooperation in our investigation.
scripts.translation: 我們派這個人去其中一個部落，請求他們協助調查。

scripts.text: Will they help us? They have already said threatening words...
scripts.translation: 他們會幫我們嗎？他們之前已經說過威脅的話了......

scripts.text: Of course they will help us. if they reject our demand, we just say that we'll ask for help from the other tribe.
scripts.translation: 當然會。如果他們拒絕我們的請求，我們就說會向另一個部落求助。

scripts.text: Right, if we do that, they will have no other choice.
scripts.translation: 沒錯，這樣一來，他們就別無選擇了。

scripts.text: In this situation, they want to avoid showing that place to the other tribe.
scripts.translation: 這種情況下，他們不想讓另一個部落知道那個地方。

scripts.text: So, they have to cooperate with us.
scripts.translation: 所以他們必須與我們合作。

scripts.text: Oh, you have a malicious idea.
That's called that Kuhotanrangjigea from east. I didn't make that by myself.
scripts.translation: 這叫“以夷制夷”。這可不是我自己想出來的。

scripts.text: Whatever.. Hey, you there... your name is {0} right? Do you know what to do?
scripts.translation: 算了......嘿，你......你{0}叫，對吧？你知道該怎麼做嗎？

scripts.text: Go to one of the tribes and ask for help officially. I'll send someone to the other tribe.
scripts.translation: 去其中一個部落，正式請求他們的幫助。我會派人去另一個部落。

scripts.text: I'm going to give you a choice. Which tribe do you want to go to?
scripts.translation: 我讓你選一個部落。你想去哪個？

scripts.text: Okay, then I place responsibility on you. from now on you focus on acquiring a good reputation with the Laphine.
scripts.translation: 好吧，這件事就交給你負責。從現在開始，你要專注於改善我們和拉斐族的關係。

scripts.text: It won't be easy to get a good impression from the Sapha again.
scripts.translation: 要重新贏得薩法族的好感可不容易。

scripts.text: So you must earn us a good reputation from the Laphine.
scripts.translation: 所以你得幫我們贏得拉斐族的好感。

scripts.text: Good. You are now responsible with building our relationship with the Laphine tribe.
scripts.translation: 很好。現在由你負責與拉斐族建立關係。

scripts.text: Go to the chief of the Laphine and if he doesn't accept our request, just say that you are going to ask for help from the Sapha.
scripts.translation: 去找拉斐族的首領。如果他不接受我們的請求，就告訴他你們打算向薩法族尋求幫助。

scripts.text: You have your orders! Now I'm going to look for an adventurer who is willing to be sent to the Sapha.
scripts.translation: 任務已下達！現在我要去找一個願意被派往薩法族的冒險者。

scripts.text: Yeah? Then think again and decide.
scripts.translation: 是嗎？那就再考慮一下，做出決定吧。

scripts.translation: 是嗎？那就再考慮一下，做出決定吧。

scripts.translation: 很好。現在由你負責與拉斐族建立關係。

scripts.translation: 去找拉斐族的首領。如果他不接受我們的請求，就告訴他你們打算向薩法族尋求幫助。

scripts.text: I'm going to look for an adventurer who is willing to be sent to the Sapha.
scripts.translation: 我要去找一個願意被派往薩法族的冒險者。

scripts.text: Good. You are now responsible with building our relationship with the Sapha tribe.
scripts.translation: 很好。現在由你負責與薩法族建立關係。

scripts.translation: 去找薩法族的首領。如果他不接受我們的請求，就告訴他你們打算向拉斐族尋求幫助。

scripts.text: You have your orders! Now I'm going to look for an adventurer who is willing to be sent to the Laphine.
scripts.translation: 任務已下達！現在我要去找一個願意被派往拉斐族的冒險者。

scripts.text: How's the activity in Laphine? They have a stern character.
scripts.translation: 拉斐族那邊情況如何？他們性子很嚴厲。

scripts.text: I'm not cut out for matching with them...ew...
scripts.translation: 我不擅長和他們打交道......嘔......

scripts.text: I'm going to send a few able men to the Sapha, you don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation: 我會派幾個得力的人去薩法族，你不用擔心。

scripts.text: How's the activity in Sapha? They have a stern character.
scripts.translation: 薩法族那邊情況如何？他們性子很嚴厲。

scripts.text: I'm not cut out for matching with them...ew...
scripts.translation: 我不擅長和他們打交道......嘔......

scripts.text: I'm going to send a few able men to the Laphine, you don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation: 我會派幾個得力的人去拉斐族，你不用擔心。

scripts.text: You've come back alive? Let us celebrate your immunity!
scripts.translation: 你居然活著回來了？來慶祝你大難不死吧！

scripts.text: Who would have thought that that outsiders would be treated so vulgar by the leaders of the other tribes?
scripts.translation: 誰能想到，其他部落的首領竟然會如此粗暴地對待外來者？

scripts.text: I have said before this thing is not the last, and certainly there is something waiting for us.
scripts.translation: 我之前就說過，這件事還沒完，肯定還有麻煩等著我們。

scripts.text: It is time for us to head out, is it not, instructor?
scripts.translation: 是時候出發了，不是嗎，指導員？

scripts.text: I am looking forward to what will happen... Whew...
scripts.translation: 我很期待接下來會發生什麼......呼......

scripts.text: *Sigh* Look at me, I used to command the desert of Morocc, but I've been deployed to a world that only God knows where...
scripts.translation: *嘆氣* 看看我，以前我還指揮著夢羅克沙漠，如今卻被派到這片連神明都不知道在哪兒的異世界......

scripts.text: Come on, that's not true. In fact, you used to be an official of a small town, and have been promoted to the commander of the expedition. Your success is almost too good to be true.
scripts.translation: 別這麼說，這可不是真的。你以前只是小鎮的一名官員，後來升任遠征隊指揮官。你的晉升順利得簡直令人難以置信。

scripts.text: Hey, boss. Can we just go through the motions until we get out of here? This so-called Ash-Vacuum is boring. It's heaven for the kingdom scholars, but it's not for me.
scripts.translation: 嘿，老闆。我們能不能敷衍一下，趕緊離開這裡？這個所謂的“阿什真空”太無聊了。對王國的學者來說是天堂，對我可不是。

scripts.text: Geez, do you have to keep calling me boss? I'm the Commander, alright? So disrespectful.
scripts.translation: 天哪，你非得一直叫我老闆嗎？要叫指揮官，懂嗎？真沒禮貌。

scripts.text: Can you guys stop complaining? God...
scripts.translation: 你們能不能別抱怨了？真是的......

scripts.text: Who are you? What business do you have with Commander Agip?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？找阿吉普指揮官有什麼事？

scripts.text: What is it? If you have too much time on your hands, you'd better go outside and find something productive to do.
scripts.translation: 怎麼了？要是閒得發慌，就出去找點正事做。

scripts.text: Phew, I'm glad the mission is over. Thank you so much for your help.
scripts.translation: 呼，很高興任務結束了。非常感謝你的幫助。

scripts.text: We'll contact you again when we have another mission for you. I hope we can count on your help again when the time comes.
scripts.translation: 有新任務時我們會再聯絡你。希望到時候還能得到你的幫助。

scripts.text: I'm Staff Officer Abidal of the Midgard Expedition. How may I help you?
scripts.translation: 我是米德加爾特遠征隊的參謀阿比達爾。有什麼事嗎？
米德加爾特遠征隊簡介
米德加爾特遠征隊的成就

scripts.text: The Midgard Expedition is conducted by a group of explorers from the three countries of Midgard and the Mercenary Association. We're here to explore the Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation: 米德加爾特遠征隊由來自米德加爾特三國的探險家和傭兵協會成員組成。我們在這裡探索阿什真空。

scripts.text: Command Hibba Agip behind me is our commander. He may appear unreliable, but he has extensive knowledge and experience in exploration.
scripts.translation: 站在我身後的希巴·阿吉普是我們的指揮官。他看起來可能不太靠譜，但在探險方面擁有廣博的知識和豐富的經驗。

scripts.text: We have many aides and scholars to support our expedition.
scripts.translation: 有許多助手和學者支援這次遠征。

scripts.text: Oh, you may know this already, but Commander Agip isn't from any of the three countries. Neither am I or Instructor Igrid.
scripts.translation: 你可能知道，阿吉普指揮官並不屬於三國中的任何一國。我和指導員伊格麗德也一樣。

scripts.text: There's an obvious power struggle among the three countries to assign their officers to the commander position.
scripts.translation: 三國之間在指派軍官擔任指揮官一職上存在明顯的權力鬥爭。

scripts.text: As a last resort, they had to select Commander Agip since he's unaffiliated with any of those countries, but is talented enough to lead the expedition.
scripts.translation: 萬般無奈之下，他們只好選阿吉普指揮官，因為他不屬於任何一國，卻有能力領導遠征隊。

scripts.text: We, the commanders, Igrid, and I aren't used to the leadership role. We're having trouble taking care of everything that's happening. *Sigh*
scripts.translation: 指揮官、伊格麗德和我都不習慣擔任領導職務。我們很難處理眼前發生的各種事情。*嘆氣*

scripts.text: The members of the Midgard Expedition are conducting various kinds of research about the Ash-Vacuum searching for possible living creatures and studying what might be beneficial for the development of the mainland.
scripts.translation: 米德加爾特遠征隊成員正在阿什真空開展各種研究，尋找可能存在的生物，並研究這裡是否有助於大陸的發展。

scripts.text: If you look around, you'll find many people in need of your help. Enjoy your stay in the otherworld, and feel free to ask me if you have questions.
scripts.translation: 在營地四處看看，你會發現很多人需要幫助。祝你在異世界過得愉快，有問題儘管來問我。

scripts.text: We're still at an early stage of the expedition, so we haven't made any major achievements. That's why we need help from adventurers like you.
scripts.translation: 我們的遠征仍處於早期階段，因此尚未取得重大成果。這就是我們需要像你這樣的冒險者幫忙的原因。

scripts.text: If you look around this camp, you'll find many opportunities to help us. We always welcome every bit of help.
scripts.translation: 看看營地周圍，你會發現很多能幫上忙的事。我們歡迎任何幫助。

scripts.text: So far, only a few truths about the Ash-Vacuum have been revealed.
scripts.translation: 到目前為止，我們只揭開了阿什真空的少數真相。

scripts.text: We now know there's a demihuman race in this otherworld, but we're too busy figuring out the true nature of the time-space gap, let alone study the demihuman race in depth.
scripts.translation: 我們已經知道這個異世界存在一個半人種族，但眼下忙著弄清次元裂縫的真正性質，更別說深入研究這個種族了。

scripts.text: My advice for you will be to be careful when you encounter members of that race. Who knows? They might be extremely hostile toward other races.
scripts.translation: 我的建議是，遇到這個種族的成員時要小心。誰知道呢？他們可能對其他種族極度敵視。

scripts.text: Oh, and take heed, unidentified creatures appear outside the camp during nighttime. Be careful of them, too.
scripts.translation: 還有，請注意，夜間營地外會出現不明生物。也要小心它們。

scripts.text: Oh, welcome back. I apologize for troubling you like this. I didn't feel to comfortable talking to you back there.
scripts.translation: 哦，歡迎回來。很抱歉這樣打擾你。剛才在那裡和你說話時，我有點不自在。

scripts.text: In fact, I have a favor to ask of you. From what I know of your accomplishments you're the right person for this.
scripts.translation: 事實上，我有一事相求。根據我對你功績的瞭解，你是最合適的人選。

scripts.text: On behalf of the expedition, I'd like to give you a mission. Would you like to accept it?
scripts.translation: 我想代表遠征隊交給你一個任務。你願意接受嗎？

scripts.text: Thank you so much. I had a good feeling about you, and I was so sure that you'd be willing to help.
scripts.translation: 非常感謝。我一看就覺得你靠得住，也相信你願意幫忙。

scripts.text: Let's cut to the chase. The mission is simple, deliver our expedition report to the three countries of Midgard.
scripts.translation: 我就直說吧。任務很簡單：把遠征報告送到米德加爾特三國。

scripts.text: But I have to tell you... We sent out three adventurers on this mission before you, and they all dissapeared. Please don't disclose this information to anyone.
scripts.translation: 但我必須告訴你......在你之前，我們曾派出三名冒險者執行這項任務，他們全都失蹤了。請不要把這件事告訴任何人。

scripts.text: The commander or I cannot leave this camp, even though delivering the report is one of our most important duties. That's why I need someone reliable and trustworthy like you.
scripts.translation: 指揮官和我都無法離開營地，儘管遞交報告是我們最重要的職責之一。所以我需要像你這樣可靠、值得信賴的人。

scripts.text: Phew, I'm so glad that you've accepted this mission. Now, please go receive the report from the commander. He'll officially assign you to the mission.
scripts.translation: 呼，太好了，你接受了任務。現在請去指揮官那裡領報告，他會正式指派你執行任務。
我會為你的出發做好準備。

scripts.text: Please go speak to the commander.
Oh, I see... Then can you help me whenever you have some time?
scripts.translation: 哦，我明白了......那你有空時能幫幫我嗎？

scripts.text: This is urgent, please think it over and come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 這件事很緊急，請再考慮一下。如果你改變主意了，就回來找我。

scripts.text: I've reported to the commander about your decision to help us.
scripts.translation: 我已經向指揮官彙報了你決定幫助我們的事。

scripts.text: You've been assinged to the mission officially. Good luck, and I hope you'll come back safely.
scripts.translation: 你已被正式指派執行任務。祝你好運，希望你能平安歸來。

scripts.text: I've heard the story. Why don't you go speak to the commander first?
scripts.translation: 我聽說過這件事。你先去和指揮官談談吧。

scripts.text: It's as what the commander said. I still remember the contents of the report, even though it might not all be accurate without any references.
scripts.translation: 正如指揮官所說。儘管沒有參考資料，內容可能不完全準確，但我仍記得報告裡的內容。

scripts.text: If you bring me the pages of the lost report, I'll fill the missing parts and be able to complete the report again.
scripts.translation: 如果你能找回丟失的報告頁，我會補上缺失部分，重新完成這份報告。

scripts.text: Why don't you go check the site of the accident? You might find some clues of their whereabouts. and...
scripts.translation: 你不妨去看看事故現場？或許能找到有關他們下落的線索。還有......

scripts.text: This is my opinion, but otherworldly creatures might have taken an interest in the pages.
scripts.translation: 這只是我的個人猜測，但異界生物可能對那些報告頁感興趣。

scripts.text: I'm thinking this because the report contains information about the ecology of the otherworldly creatures. It's also made of paper and ink, materials from the mainland that might seem interesting to those creatures.
scripts.translation: 我這麼想是因為報告裡有關於異界生物生態的資訊。而且報告是用紙張和墨水製作的，這些來自大陸的材料可能會引起它們的興趣。

scripts.text: Anyways, please bring the pages of the report in ^0000FFincrements of 10^000000 whenever you find them. I'll try to put them in order.
scripts.translation: 總之，請將找到的報告頁湊^0000FF齊10頁後^000000交給我。我會試著把它們整理好。

scripts.translation: 我這麼想是因為報告裡有關於異界生物生態的資訊。而且報告是用紙張和墨水製作的，這些來自大陸的材料可能會引起它們的興趣。

scripts.text: Anyways, please bring the pages of the report in ^0000FFincrements of 10^000000 whenever you find them. I'll try to put them in order.
scripts.translation: 總之，請將找到的報告頁湊^0000FF齊10頁後^000000交給我。我會試著把它們整理好。

scripts.text: How have you been doing with finding the report's lost pages?
scripts.translation: 你尋找報告遺失頁面的進展如何？

scripts.text: Feel free to tell me whenever you're ready.

scripts.translation: 哦，你已經收集到足夠的頁面了......

scripts.text: Phew, I'm glad we can resume the mission again.

scripts.text: ...Aren't you leaving? I think you should.

scripts.text: I heard that you got a new duty from Commander Agip.
scripts.translation: 我聽說你從阿吉普指揮官那裡接到了新任務。

scripts.text: ...Aren't you leaving? I think you should.

scripts.text: Hello, I'm Staff Officer Abidal. Safe travels, Adventurer.
scripts.translation: 你好，我是參謀阿比達爾。一路順風，冒險者。

scripts.text: Hey, rookies. I guess you were lucky enough to complete the mission.
scripts.translation: 嘿，新人。看來你們運氣不錯，完成了任務。

scripts.text: This is not the end. Keep yourself in one piece until we need your services again.
scripts.translation: 這還沒結束。等我們再次需要你們幫忙時，你們可得好好保重。

scripts.text: I'm Instructor Igrid of the Midgard Expedition. I'm in charge of training and commanding soldiers.
scripts.translation: 我是米德加爾特遠征隊的指導員伊格麗德，負責訓練和指揮士兵。

scripts.text: You must want to become an official member of our expedition.
scripts.translation: 你一定想成為遠征隊的正式成員吧。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but you're too weak to endure my intensive training.
scripts.translation: 很抱歉，你太弱了，無法承受我的強化訓練。

scripts.text: Give up before you get hurt.
If you have too much time on your hands, look around. There's plenty of chores available for so-called adventurers's like you.
scripts.translation: 閒著沒事就四處看看。像你這樣的所謂冒險者，有的是雜活可做。

scripts.text: If you do your best to do them, I might accept you as a trainee on this expedition.
scripts.translation: 好好幹的話，我或許會收你做遠征隊的學員。

scripts.text: I don't trust you. Hm. Sorry. I don't really have the right to say that if the commander has assigned you to the mission.
scripts.translation: 我不信任你。嗯，抱歉。如果指揮官已經指派你執行任務，我其實沒有資格這麼說。

scripts.text: If you're going to give up, give up now. That'll be better for both of us.
scripts.translation: 如果你打算放棄，現在就放棄吧。這樣對我們雙方都好。

scripts.text: I knew you couldn't do it. Didn't I tell you to give up when you had the chance?!
scripts.translation: 我就知道你做不成。我不是告訴過你，有機會就放棄嗎？！

scripts.text: Do you think I'm doing this for you? No, I'm just using this chance to discipline idle soldiers.
scripts.translation: 你以為我這麼做是為了你嗎？不，我只是借這個機會管教一下那些無所事事計程車兵。

scripts.text: What are you looking at? Go mind your own business!
scripts.translation: 你在看什麼？管好你自己的事！

scripts.text: I am Expedition Training Instructor Igrid, and the commander responsible for training soldiers.
scripts.translation: 我是遠征隊訓練指導員伊格麗德，負責訓練士兵。

scripts.text: Welcome, I've been waiting for you.
You must be {0}. Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation: 你一定是吧{0}。很高興見到你。

scripts.text: Let me check something quicly. You received the report directly from the commander, didn't you? May I see it?
scripts.translation: 讓我快速確認一下。你是直接從指揮官那裡收到報告的吧？可以給我看看嗎？

scripts.text: Excellent. Thank you. Then we'll go back to the mainland and let the leaders know that you, {0}, have departed.
scripts.translation: 很好，謝謝。我們現在要回大陸，通知各國領導人：你，，已{0}經出發了。
你，去修瓦爾茲巴魯德共和國。

scripts.text: And you, take Arunafeltz. I'll visit Prontera Palace.
scripts.translation: 你去阿魯納菲茲。我去普隆德拉王宮。

scripts.text: What's up? Why haven't you left...?
scripts.translation: 怎麼了？你為什麼還沒出發......？

scripts.text: Argh... Why are you doing this?!
Wha... What are you doing? You can't give up the report...
scripts.translation: 什......你在做什麼？你不能把報告交出去......

scripts.text: Haha, I may have failed to take the report, but it's better destroyed than in your hands!
scripts.translation: 哈哈，雖然我沒能拿到報告，但讓它被毀掉總比落在你們手裡好！

scripts.translation: 你是受命運送遠征隊報告的嗎？

scripts.translation: 抱歉，我沒看到你手裡拿著報告。請把報告帶來，我要核實你的身份。

scripts.translation: 你好！我在這裡等人。嗯，這是我的職責。

scripts.text: - When you tried to talk to him, he disappeared into thin air. He looked like someone on a very important mission... -

scripts.text: Good day. I'm from the Third Scout Party under direct command of the commander of the Midgard Expedition.
scripts.translation: 你好。我是米德加爾特遠征隊指揮官直屬的第三偵察隊成員。

scripts.text: I've been ordered by Instructor Igrid to conduct a search for something.
scripts.translation: 我受指導員伊格麗德之命，正在搜尋某樣東西。

scripts.translation: 尋找遺失頁面比我想的困難。等我完成這一輪搜尋後再來吧。

scripts.translation: 你是誰？為什麼想知道我們的搜尋結果？你是軍隊的人嗎？

scripts.text: Man, don't you know that you can be arrested for interrupting a military operation?
scripts.translation: 喂，你不知道干擾軍事行動會被逮捕嗎？

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I'm on duty. Why don't we talk later when I'm off-duty?
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我正在執勤。等我下班後再聊吧。

scripts.text: I'm Laur, the aide of the Home Minister of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. Do you have any business with me?
scripts.translation: 我是勞爾，盧恩·米德加爾特王國內務大臣的助手。你有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text: Oh, you brought me the report from the Midgard Expedition. What took you so long? I received a message about your departure a long time ago.
scripts.translation: 哦，你帶來了米德加爾特遠征隊的報告。怎麼花了這麼久？我很久以前就收到你出發的訊息了。

scripts.text: Well, tell the commander that I'm not happy with your tardiness. Now, give me the report.
scripts.translation: 好吧，告訴指揮官，我對你們遲到很不滿。現在，把報告給我。

scripts.text: I knew it was the wrong idea to out a mercenary in the commander position. See, nothing is done on time. Gosh!
scripts.translation: 我就知道讓傭兵擔任指揮官是個錯誤的決定。看吧，什麼事都沒能準時完成。真是的！

scripts.text: *Ahem Ahem* Thank you for bringing me the report. I guess I was wrong about the commander. This report is actually very well done.
scripts.translation: *咳咳* 謝謝你把報告帶給我。看來是我誤會指揮官了。這份報告做得確實很好。

scripts.text: But don't forget to tell him that I need the expedition reports on time from now on. Alright? *Ahem*
scripts.translation: 但別忘了告訴他，從現在開始，遠征隊報告必須準時交上來。明白了嗎？*咳*

scripts.text: Why are you back? You've delivered the report to me already. Are you suffering from amnesia or something?
scripts.translation: 你怎麼又回來了？你不是已經把報告交給我了嗎？你失憶了嗎？

scripts.text: You should leave and go back to your work.
I'm Laur, the aide of the Home Minister of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. Do you have any business with me?
scripts.translation: 我是勞爾，盧恩·米德加爾特王國內務大臣的助手。你有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text: Can you sense the great disorder occuring on the Midgard Continent and the Rune-Midgarts' Kingdom?
scripts.translation: 你能感受到米德加爾特大陸和盧恩·米德加爾特王國正發生的巨大動盪嗎？

scripts.text: Still, there always a silver lining, no matter how dangerous this world may become.
scripts.translation: 不過，無論這個世界變得多麼危險，總有一線希望。

scripts.text: There is hope and opportunity beyond the chaos, and I see the world beyond the time-space gap as a source of new hope.
scripts.translation: 混亂之中仍有希望和機遇。我認為次元裂縫另一邊的世界正是新希望的源泉。

scripts.text: Welcome, stranger. How can I help you?
scripts.translation: 歡迎，旅人。有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: Oh, I see. You've brought me a report from the expedition beyond the time-space gap.
scripts.translation: 哦，我明白了。你帶來的是來自次元裂縫另一邊的遠征報告。

scripts.text: I regret admitting that you've brought it much later than I expected, but... I'm glad it is here safely. Please give it to me.
scripts.translation: 很遺憾，你交得比我預期的晚了許多，不過......很高興報告平安送到了。請交給我吧。

scripts.text: I'm happy to see that they've made good progress so far. Please tell the commander to keep up the good work.
scripts.translation: 很高興看到他們目前進展順利。請告訴指揮官繼續努力。

scripts.text: Excuse me, but it's time to pray now. Please be safe on your travels.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，現在是祈禱的時間。祝你旅途平安。

scripts.text: Oh, right, I already received the report from you. Don't worry, you didn't forget.
scripts.translation: 哦，對了，我已經收到你的報告了。別擔心，你沒忘記。

scripts.text: Please be safe on your way back to the expedition camp.
Good day, stranger. May Freya bless you.
scripts.translation: 祝你今天愉快，旅人。願芙蕾雅保佑你。

scripts.text: Welcome, {0}. What took you so long?
Oh, who am I? Let's say... That you can make ends meet because of me.
scripts.translation: 哦，我是誰？這麼說吧......你能維持生計，多虧了我。

scripts.text: Do you know how long I waited for this report? *Sigh* ...Fine, just give it to me.
scripts.translation: 你知道我等這份報告等了多久嗎？*嘆氣*......算了，給我吧。

scripts.text: Hmmm... This report is a clear demonstration of Commander Hibba Agip's competence... Well, that's great.
scripts.translation: 嗯......這份報告充分展現了希巴·阿吉普指揮官的能力......好吧，很不錯。

scripts.text: Thank you for bringing the report.
Please tell the commander to keep up the good work.
scripts.translation: 請告訴指揮官繼續努力。

scripts.text: Now excuse me, I must go back to work.
scripts.translation: 那麼失陪了，我得回去工作。

scripts.text: What is it? Do you still have business with me?
Please go back to the commander, and tell him to keep up the good work.
scripts.translation: 請回去告訴指揮官繼續努力。

scripts.text: What is it? I don't have time for chitchat.
If you have business with me. please talk to my secretary and schedule an appointment. My office is on the second floor.
scripts.translation: 如果有公事找我，請和我的秘書預約。我的辦公室在二樓。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 攜帶物品過多時，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text: Oh adventurer, you've come at the perfect time.
scripts.translation: 哦，冒險者，你來得正是時候。

scripts.text: Since you and I both know that we can't waste time on idle chitchat,
scripts.translation: 既然你我都知道時間寶貴，不能浪費在閒聊上，

scripts.text: Most expeditions come to this area to explore the Ash Vacuum,
scripts.translation: 多數遠征隊來到這裡是為了探索阿什真空，

scripts.text: but we've come here for a different reason.
You know about this space gap that was caused by Satan Morocc, don't you?
scripts.translation: 你知道魔王夢羅克造成的這道次元裂縫，對吧？

scripts.text: Our job is to pursue Satan Morocc and figure out how this all happened.
scripts.translation: 我們的任務是追蹤魔王夢羅克，弄清楚這一切是如何發生的。

scripts.text: Your job is to assist us, and prove that you can be a good member of our expedition.
scripts.translation: 你的任務是協助我們，並證明自己能勝任遠征隊成員。

scripts.text: ... Umm... So, you'll have to.. Let me think which job would be perfect for you.
scripts.translation: ......嗯......那麼，你得......讓我想想什麼工作最適合你。

scripts.text: Umm.. I remember someone said that he needed assistance...
scripts.translation: 嗯......我記得有人說過需要幫手......

scripts.text: Ah, I know what you can do!
scripts.translation: 啊，我知道你能做什麼了！

scripts.text: There's a guy conducting an investigation near the space gap. You can go help him.
scripts.translation: 有個人正在次元裂縫附近調查。你去幫幫他。

scripts.text: Just do what he asks you to do, alright?
scripts.translation: 他說什麼你就照做，好嗎？

scripts.text: Well, {0}, I've just assigned you as Mr. Kidd's assistant.
scripts.translation: 好了，{0}，我剛任命你為基德先生的助手。

scripts.text: Good, everything's done on this end. I just needed to get your name on record.
scripts.translation: 很好，這邊的手續都辦完了。我只是要把你的名字登記下來。

scripts.text: What are you still doing here?
{0}, your job is to assist Mr. Kidd.
Please go help him, will you?
Only authorized personnel can enter this area.
scripts.translation: 只有獲准的人員才能進入這個區域。

scripts.text: Go back to the mainland as quickly as possible.
Your job is to assist Mr. Kidd who's standing near the space gap, otherwise known as the gate.
scripts.translation: 你的工作是協助站在次元裂縫（也就是大門）附近的基德先生。

scripts.text: You're irresponsible. How could you abandon such an important duty?
scripts.translation: 真不負責任，怎麼能丟下這麼重要的職責？

scripts.text: If you don't want to work, why did you even come here to the Ash Vacuum in the first place?
scripts.translation: 如果你不想工作，當初為什麼要來阿什真空？

scripts.text: Alas! There's no one I can trust!
scripts.translation: 唉！沒有我可以信任的人！

scripts.text: You know, when I was working at the palace, I was.. *Blah Blah*...
scripts.translation: 你知道嗎，我在宮殿工作時......*絮絮叨叨*......

scripts.text: - Her rant doesn't seem to be ending any time soon. You'd better go back and help Mr. Kidd, even if your heart's not in it. -
scripts.translation: - 她的抱怨似乎一時半會兒停不下來。你最好還是回去幫基德先生，哪怕心裡並不情願。 -

scripts.text: Hm? Where are you going? I'm not finished!
scripts.translation: 嗯？你要去哪裡？我還沒說完呢！

scripts.text: Mr. Kidd is such a great young man.
scripts.translation: 基德先生真是個優秀的年輕人。

scripts.text: You should be thankful that I've assigned you to help him. Don't be lazy by neglecting your duties.
scripts.translation: 你應該感激我派你去協助他。別偷懶，做好自己的工作。

scripts.text: I knew you would successfully complete your duties.
scripts.translation: 我就知道你能順利完成任務。

scripts.text: So, tell me; how can I help you?
scripts.translation: 那麼，有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: A scholar who is familiar with magic?
What about that old man over there? If you couldn't tell, he comes from a distant country.
scripts.translation: 那邊那位老人怎麼樣？看不出來嗎，他來自遙遠的國度。

scripts.text: Why are you looking for a scholar, anyway?
scripts.translation: 對了，你為什麼要找學者？

scripts.text: Did Mr. Kidd ask you to find one?
scripts.translation: 是基德先生讓你去找的嗎？

scripts.text: I see. He's probably looking for a solution for the spell scroll.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。他大概是在尋找解決魔法卷軸問題的辦法。

scripts.text: Then yes, that old man would be the perfect person to ask.
scripts.translation: 那麼，那位老人正好能幫上忙。

scripts.text: He's from Arunafeltz, and has extensive knowledge in magic as well as sacred power.
scripts.translation: 他來自阿魯納菲茲，對魔法和神聖力量都很有研究。

scripts.text: I'm sure he'll be able to help you.
Do you see an old man over there? He's trying to make a fire with wet firewood to roast a sweet potato.
scripts.translation: 你看到那邊那位老人了嗎？他正試圖用溼柴生火烤紅薯。

scripts.text: Why don't you go show it to him? He might be able to help Mr. Kidd with what he is trying to do.
scripts.translation: 不妨拿給他看看？他也許能幫基德先生解決眼前的問題。

scripts.text: If you're seeking advice about the spell scroll, you should go talk to Mr. Defaria.
scripts.translation: 如果你想諮詢魔法卷軸的問題，就去找德法里亞先生。

scripts.text: I don't practice magic, so I wouldn't know anything about it.
scripts.translation: 我不懂魔法，所以幫不上忙。

scripts.text: ...Basically it all comes down to Rayan.
scripts.translation: ......說到底，這一切都和拉揚有關。

scripts.text: He's been abducted by Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation: 他被魔王夢羅克綁架了。

scripts.text: If we find Rayan using this location-tracing spell.
scripts.translation: 如果我們用這個定位法術找到拉揚......
我們也能找到魔王夢羅克！

scripts.text: But it'll work only if Satan Morocc actually abducted Rayan.
scripts.translation: 但前提是魔王夢羅克確實綁架了拉揚。

scripts.text: Say, what's the tracing pattern number?
scripts.translation: 那麼，追蹤圖案的編號是多少？

scripts.text: This location-tracing spell uses a pair of magic stones of the same wavelength...
scripts.translation: 這個定位法術需要一對波長相同的魔法石......

scripts.text: We can use the spell with one stone to find the other stone with the matching wavelength.
scripts.translation: 我們可以用一塊石頭施法，尋找另一塊波長相同的石頭。

scripts.text: We'll analyze this pattern number and detect the wavelength.
scripts.translation: 我們會解析這個編號並檢測波長。

scripts.text: It'll take some time before we get the results.
scripts.translation: 得到結果還需要一些時間。

scripts.text: It's not working for some reason.
I can't find a magic stone that has the same wavelength as yours.
scripts.translation: 我找不到與你的波長相同的魔法石。

scripts.text: This location-tracing spell uses a pair of magic stones of the same wavelength..
scripts.translation: 這個定位法術需要一對波長相同的魔法石......

scripts.text: I can't find a magic stone that has the same wavelength as your pattern number.
scripts.translation: 我找不到與你的編號波長相同的魔法石。

scripts.text: I hope they've been able to trace the wavelength by now.
scripts.translation: 希望他們已經追蹤到波長了。

scripts.text: How'd you like to go check the results?
To the south of this camp, you'll see a building with a mana detector attached to it.
scripts.translation: 在營地南邊，你會看到一座裝有瑪娜探測器的建築。

scripts.text: Go ask the building manager about the trace results.
scripts.translation: 去問問那裡的管理員追蹤結果。

scripts.text: Tracing magic wavelength is not easy as you think.
scripts.translation: 追蹤魔法波長並不像你想像的那麼容易。

scripts.text: Please be patient: the results will arrive soon enough.
scripts.translation: 請耐心等待，結果很快就會出來。

scripts.text: I'm in charge of tracing the wavelength from the Midgard Continent,
scripts.translation: 我負責追蹤米德加爾特大陸的波長，

scripts.text: and the south camp is tracing it in this area.
scripts.translation: 南邊的營地負責追蹤這個區域的波長。

scripts.text: I asked them to assign top priority to this task, so with any luck, they've finished it by now.
scripts.translation: 我讓他們把這項任務列為最高優先順序，希望他們現在已經完成了。

scripts.text: ..What are you doing? I said, go ask the building manager about the trace results.
scripts.translation: ......你還在這裡做什麼？我說了，去問管理員追蹤結果。

scripts.text: - You told her exactly what you were told by the soldier managing the building. -
scripts.translation: - 你把負責管理建築計程車兵告訴你的話原原本本轉述給她。 -

scripts.text: Oh, is that the case? I see.
That means.. The man called Rayan isn't on the Midgard Continent or in this Ash Vacuum.
scripts.translation: 也就是說......那個叫拉揚的男子不在米德加爾特大陸，也不在阿什真空。

scripts.text: As I suspected, he must be with Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation: 正如我所料，他一定和魔王夢羅克在一起。

scripts.text: Pursuing Satan Morocc was supposed to be our last resort..
scripts.translation: 追蹤魔王夢羅克原本是我們的最後手段......

scripts.text: ...I guess we have no choice now..
...I should log a report entry into this journal.
scripts.translation: ......我應該把報告記在這本日誌裡。

scripts.text: Our pursuit of Satan Morocc is at an end for now.
scripts.translation: 我們暫時停止追捕魔王夢羅克。

scripts.text: You did a great job helping us, and went above and beyond my expectations.
scripts.translation: 你幫了大忙，表現超出了我的預期。

scripts.text: Here, this is a reward for your help.
Keep up the good work assisting the explorers in this camp.
scripts.translation: 繼續協助這個營地的探險家們。

scripts.text: Why do you keep giving me that dirty look?!
scripts.translation: 你為什麼一直用那種眼神看我？！

scripts.text: Are you annoying me on purpose?
Go and find something else to do!
I'm stressed out and I've got a headache writing this report. I don't have the time to deal with you right now.
scripts.translation: 我壓力很大，寫這份報告讓我頭疼。我現在沒空理你。

scripts.text: What is it that worries you?
Please, I've got enough worries already.
So, tell me, what is it?
{0}, you've done a great job helping us...
Oh, you must have questions about that last case, is that right?
scripts.translation: 哦，你一定是對上次的事件有疑問吧？

scripts.text: ...Wait, are you worried because of him?
scripts.translation: ......等等，你是因為他才擔心的嗎？

scripts.text: ...I see, you're worried about him being supported by the country.
scripts.translation: ......我明白了，你擔心他會得到國家的支援。

scripts.text: This isn't a good time to disclose the truth. It'll cause more confusion.
scripts.translation: 現在不是揭露真相的好時機，只會引起更多混亂。

scripts.text: I believe the diplomats and presidents of both countries are responsible for those national matters.
scripts.translation: 我相信兩國的外交官和領導人會負責處理這些國家事務。

scripts.text: This is out of your hands, adventurer.
scripts.translation: 這件事不是你能左右的，冒險者。

scripts.text: So stop worrying about it. Alright?
No country wants to start a war, especially when we have a greater common enemy.
scripts.translation: 沒有哪個國家想挑起戰爭，尤其是我們還有一個更強大的共同敵人。

scripts.text: Just focus on what you can do to help us.
scripts.translation: 專心做你能做的事，幫助我們吧。

scripts.text: We've stopped pursuing Satan Morocc, so you may go help the other explorers now.
scripts.translation: 我們已經停止追捕魔王夢羅克了，你現在可以去幫助其他探險者。

scripts.text: I've already rewarded you for your services.
scripts.translation: 我已經為你的協助付過報酬了。

scripts.text: Remember; don't open your mouth about this to anyone.
scripts.translation: 記住，別向任何人透露這件事。

scripts.text: What is it? I thought you've been discharged from my service.
scripts.translation: 怎麼了？我以為你已經不再替我辦事了。

scripts.text: Did that old man send these?
Nothing good can come out of this if it's released to the public.
scripts.translation: 如果這件事公之於眾，不會有任何好事發生。

scripts.text: Arunafeltz has replaced their leaders with the moderates just recently.
scripts.translation: 阿魯納菲茲最近剛由溫和派取代了原來的領導層。

scripts.text: Shoving the remnants of the radicals in front of them is extremely dangerous.
scripts.translation: 把激進派的殘餘勢力推到他們面前，極其危險。

scripts.text: We've finally made a truce with them.
scripts.translation: 我們終於和他們達成了停戰協議。

scripts.text: Their sins will not be forgiven, but we won't make a stupid attempt to get revenge and end up shedding more blood!
scripts.translation: 他們的罪行不會被原諒，但我們不會愚蠢地復仇，害得更多人流血！

scripts.text: Let the politicians do their job.
scripts.translation: 讓政治家們處理他們的事吧。

scripts.text: I assure you they won't lead us to the worst case scenario. That's what you're worried about, right?
scripts.translation: 我保證他們不會讓局勢發展到最糟。這正是你擔心的，對吧？

scripts.text: Do you want us to wage war against Arunafeltz over this?!
scripts.translation: 你想因為這件事對阿魯納菲茲開戰嗎？！

scripts.text: Let me ask you to forget the past and focus on the present.
scripts.translation: 請你忘記過去，專注於現在。

scripts.text: For everyone's sake, please just look toward the future and move forward.
scripts.translation: 為了大家，請放眼未來，繼續向前。

scripts.text: We won't do anything that you'd morally oppose.
scripts.translation: 我們不會做任何違揹你道義的事。

scripts.text: You believe in peace, don't you?
Tell him that I'm grateful for these sweet potatoes, anyway..
scripts.translation: 總之，替我謝謝他送來的紅薯......

scripts.text: Err? I don't have two Nice Sweet Potatoes..
scripts.translation: 咦？我沒有兩個美味紅薯......

scripts.text: Let us take care of the rest.
I'm not suggesting that we should pretend as if the past never happened. All I'm saying is that we should work towards achieving a greater cause.
scripts.translation: 我不是說要假裝過去從未發生過，而是說我們應該為更大的目標而努力。

scripts.text: I suppose I have an eye for people after all.
scripts.translation: 看來我確實有識人的眼光。

scripts.text: Keep up the good work, will you?

scripts.translation: 是紫錐菊船長派你來的嗎？

scripts.text: I have something to report to you.
The magic wavelength of the requested pattern number has not been detected in this area.
scripts.translation: 在這個區域沒有探測到指定編號對應的魔法波長。

scripts.text: It's not possible to trace the number around this area, but..
scripts.translation: 無法在這裡追蹤該編號，不過......

scripts.text: I can tell this magic pattern is supposed to be used to trace a human being.
scripts.translation: 我看得出，這個魔法圖案是用來追蹤某個人的。

scripts.text: You know tracing magic stones always come in pairs, don't you?
scripts.translation: 追蹤用的魔法石總是成對出現，你知道吧？

scripts.text: Now, magic stones specifically used to trace humans have a special feature.
scripts.translation: 專門用於追蹤人類的魔法石有個特殊性質。

scripts.text: When the target of the trace dies, the pair of stones are automatically destroyed.
scripts.translation: 追蹤目標死亡時，成對的魔法石會自動銷燬。

scripts.text: Since this patterned magic stone is still intact..
scripts.translation: 既然這塊帶有圖案的魔法石還完好無損......

scripts.text: Well, this magic stone serves as proof that the target of the trace is still alive somewhere in the world.
scripts.translation: 也就是說，這塊魔法石可以證明，追蹤目標仍然活在世界某處。

scripts.text: Hopefully, we'll detect the same wavelength.
scripts.translation: 希望能探測到相同的波長。

scripts.text: Please report this to Captain Echinacea;
scripts.translation: 請把結果報告給紫錐菊船長：

scripts.text: We've failed to trace the location of the target,
scripts.translation: 我們沒能追蹤到目標的位置，

scripts.text: This device detects mana and magic wavelengths around this area. identifying what enemies we're dealing with.
scripts.translation: 這個裝置能探測周圍瑪娜和魔法波長的變化，幫助我們識別正在面對的敵人。

scripts.text: It can be used to trace the wavelengths of location-tracing spells.
scripts.translation: 也能用來追蹤定位法術的波長。

scripts.text: It's a fantastic product made from a combination of magic and science.
scripts.translation: 這是魔法與科學結合的傑作。

scripts.text: The Ash Vacuum hasn't been fully explored, and we don't know what kind of dangers to expect in this area.
scripts.translation: 阿什真空尚未被完全探索，我們不知道在這裡會遇到什麼危險。

scripts.text: By using this device, we can check the change and flow of mana around this area,
scripts.translation: 使用這個裝置，我們可以檢測這片區域瑪娜的變化和流動，

scripts.text: and prepare for any possible threats.
scripts.translation: 併為可能出現的威脅做好準備。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 攜帶物品過多時，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text: Don't get too close to anything except the gate.
scripts.translation: 除了大門，別靠近任何東西。

scripts.text: An assistant? I don't think I need one, but...
scripts.translation: 助手？我覺得自己不需要助手，不過......

scripts.text: I guess I should give you something to do.
scripts.translation: 還是給你安排點事做吧。

scripts.text: Do you mind if I entrust you with a chore?
scripts.translation: 你願意幫我做點雜事嗎？

scripts.text: No, I don't mind at all.
Then why did you come all this way?
scripts.translation: 那你大老遠跑來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: I didn't really need any help to begin with. If you don't want to work, then stop bothering me.
scripts.translation: 我本來就不需要任何幫助。如果你不想工作，就別來煩我。

scripts.text: If you don't want to help us out then go back to Echinacea and let her know yourself!
scripts.translation: 如果你不想幫忙，就回去親自告訴紫錐菊！

scripts.text: I don't know if Echinacea told you this already, but we are here
scripts.translation: ....不知道紫錐菊有沒有告訴你，

scripts.text: to follow the traces of Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation: 我們在這裡是為了追蹤魔王夢羅克的蹤跡。

scripts.text: Some of us are here in the Ash Vacuum, and the rest are on the Midgard Continent.
scripts.translation: 我們一部分人在阿什真空，另一部分人在米德加爾特大陸。

scripts.text: We exchange information with our colleagues in Morocc on a regular basis, but we haven't heard from them for a while.
scripts.translation: 我們定期和夢羅克的同事交換情報，但有段時間沒收到他們的訊息了。

scripts.text: How'd you like to go gather some information for me?
scripts.translation: 你願意替我去打聽些訊息嗎？

scripts.text: It should be simple, so you I hope you'll be able to handle this.
scripts.translation: 這事應該很簡單，希望你能勝任。

scripts.text: At Southwest Morocc, you'll find an underground tavern.
scripts.translation: 夢羅克西南邊有一家地下酒館。

scripts.text: Tell her I've sent you, and she'll take care of you.
scripts.translation: 告訴她是我派你去的，她會招待你。

scripts.text: If you don't have any business here, then step aside. It's too dangerous.
scripts.translation: 如果你在這裡沒有正事，就讓開。這裡太危險了。

scripts.text: You might not be able to return to this world if you enter a route that hasn't been properly identified.
scripts.translation: 如果你進入一條尚未確認的路線，可能就無法回到這個世界。

scripts.text: I guess she forced you to do this, huh? Don't worry; you're not the first victim of her bossiness.
scripts.translation: 看來她是逼你來做這個的，對吧？別擔心，你不是第一個被她強勢作風逼來的。

scripts.text: You should tell her if you really don't want to work for me.
scripts.translation: 如果你真的不想替我工作，就告訴她。

scripts.text: I can tell you aren't so happy with this, huh?
scripts.translation: 我看出來你對此並不太高興。

scripts.text: While you're here, why don't you help us out and see where it goes?
scripts.translation: 既然你已經來了，何不幫個忙，看看接下來會怎樣？

scripts.text: Don't worry, I won't give you a hard time...
scripts.translation: 別擔心，我不會讓你太辛苦......

scripts.text: I don't know if Echinacea told you this already, but we are here to follow the traces of Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation: ....不知道紫錐菊有沒有告訴你，我們在這裡是為了追蹤魔王夢羅克的蹤跡。

scripts.text: Some of us are here in the Ash Vacuum, and the rest are on the Midgard Continent.
scripts.translation: 我們一部分人在阿什真空，另一部分人在米德加爾特大陸。

scripts.text: We exchange information with our colleagues in Morocc on a regular basis, but we haven't heard from them for a while.
scripts.translation: 我們定期與夢羅克那邊的同事交換情報，但已經有一段時間沒收到他們的訊息了。

scripts.text: How'd you like to go gather some information for me?
scripts.translation: 你願意替我去打聽些訊息嗎？

scripts.text: It should be simple, so you I hope you'll be able to handle this.
scripts.translation: 這事應該很簡單，希望你能勝任。

scripts.text: At Southwest Morocc, you'll find an underground tavern.
scripts.translation: 夢羅克西南邊有一家地下酒館。

scripts.text: Tell her I've sent you, and she'll take care of you.
scripts.translation: 告訴她是我派你來的，她會照顧你。
