scripts.text: Let me explain one more time.
Go speak to Rin in an underground tavern at Southwest Morocc.
scripts.translation: 去夢羅克西南邊的地下酒館找琳恩。

scripts.text: You won't miss the tavern if you look for a boy named Jack standing out the front.
scripts.translation: 門口站著一個叫傑克的男孩，很容易認出來。

scripts.text: I heard Rin is wounded and bedridden...
scripts.translation: 我聽說琳恩受傷了，臥床不起......

scripts.text: - Instead of an answer, you gave him Rin's journal and the bloody crystal.-
scripts.translation: - 你沒有回答，而是把琳恩的日記和沾血的結晶遞給了他。 -

scripts.text: ...A journal? I see. Hopefully this'll help me understand the situation..
scripts.translation: ......一本日記？我明白了。希望這能幫我瞭解情況......

scripts.text: So Rayan has finally been located, huh?
scripts.translation: 看來拉揚終於被找到了。

scripts.text: There was a skirmish at the mountain, and.. a raid...
scripts.translation: 山上發生了小規模衝突......還有一次突襲......

scripts.text: I mean Rin. How is she?
scripts.translation: 我是說琳恩。她怎麼樣了？

scripts.text: She needs to spend some time in bed,
scripts.translation: 她需要臥床休息一段時間，

scripts.text: but she's conscious and still in one piece.
scripts.translation: 但意識清醒，身體也沒有大礙。

scripts.text: She seems to have no problem taking care of herself,
scripts.translation: 她看起來還能自理，但我有點擔心，

scripts.text: but I'm worried because sometimes she looks extremely exhausted. She mentioned that her vision blurs when she's very tired..
scripts.translation: 因為她有時顯得極度疲憊。她說自己累壞時視線會變得模糊......

scripts.text: Don't worry; I don't think it's serious because she still had the strength to yell while writing that journal.
scripts.translation: 別擔心，我覺得不嚴重。她寫那篇日記的時候還有力氣大喊大叫呢。

scripts.text: I asked about her because I don't want her injury to interfere with our schedule.
scripts.translation: 我問她是因為不希望她的傷勢影響我們的日程。

scripts.text: As for you, I want you to come back later.
I need you to substitute for Rin until she recovers..
scripts.translation: 我需要你代替琳恩，直到她康復......

scripts.text: Hm, thanks for all your help.
Now, would you leave me alone for a while? I need to write a report based on the findings in this journal.
scripts.translation: 現在，能讓我一個人待一會兒嗎？我得根據這本日記裡的發現寫一份報告。

scripts.text: (I was supposed to give him the 'Morocc Pursuit Journal' and a 'Bloody Crystal of the Darkness'...
scripts.translation: （我本該把《夢羅克追蹤日誌》和《黑暗的血色結晶體》交給他......

scripts.text: Err? Where have they gone? I need to find them.)
scripts.translation: 咦？它們去哪兒了？我得找找。）

scripts.text: Kidd is standing at the side of the space gap, leafing through the journal's pages and taking notes.
scripts.translation: 基德站在次元裂縫旁，翻閱日記並做著筆記。

scripts.text: The 'Bloody Crystal of Darkness' is sitting aside, and remains untouched.
scripts.translation: “黑暗的血色結晶體”放在一旁，沒人碰過。

scripts.text: I feel the crystal resonating with the space gap.
scripts.translation: 我感覺結晶體在與次元裂縫產生共鳴。

scripts.text: I suddenly have the urge to touch the crystal...
scripts.translation: 我突然有一種想要觸碰它的衝動......

scripts.text: Err? What are you trying to do?
I'm sorry if I bothered you while you were writing your report.
- Kidd stopped you from touching the crystal, but somehow, it still captivates you. -
scripts.translation: - 基德阻止了你觸碰結晶體，但不知為何，它依然吸引著你。 -

scripts.text: Rin! Where's Rin? What about Rayan?
scripts.translation: 琳恩！琳恩在哪兒？拉揚呢？

scripts.text: Where the hell have you been?
..Oh yeah, I saw Rin fighting Rayan.
scripts.translation: ......哦對，我看到琳恩在和拉揚戰鬥。

scripts.text: She was defeated by magic, and then disappeared...
scripts.translation: 她被魔法擊敗，然後消失了......

scripts.text: I heard your voice once I found a strange scroll.
scripts.translation: 我找到一張奇怪卷軸時，聽到了你的聲音。

scripts.text: - Ignoring the confused look on Mr. Kidd's face, you searched your pockets, and found the mysterious scroll. -
scripts.translation: - 無視基德先生困惑的表情，你摸了摸口袋，找到了那張神秘的卷軸。 -

scripts.text: - It wasn't a dream after all... What you saw actually happened. -
scripts.translation: - 原來不是夢......你看到的確實發生了。 -

scripts.text: - You show Kidd the scroll and tell him what happened. -
scripts.translation: - 你向基德展示卷軸，並告訴他發生了什麼。 -

scripts.text: you found this from a member of Rayan's gang?
scripts.translation: 你是在拉揚團伙的成員身上找到這張卷軸的？

scripts.text: it's a scroll containing a magic spell that can be used by anyone, even if they aren't trained as mages.
scripts.translation: 這是一張魔法卷軸，任何人都可以使用，即使沒有受過魔法訓練。

scripts.text: Hmm, this scroll is sealed and needs some kind of pass code to use it.
scripts.translation: 嗯，這張卷軸被封印了，需要某種密碼才能使用。

scripts.text: I'll consult with the camp scholars about this scroll later.
scripts.translation: 我稍後會請營地的學者研究這張卷軸。

scripts.text: By the way, I saw you touch this 'Bloody Crystal of Darkness.'
scripts.translation: 順便說一下，我看到你觸碰了這塊“黑暗的血色結晶體”。

scripts.text: There was a bright flash of light around you, and then you were suddenly drawn into the space gap.
scripts.translation: 你周圍閃過一道亮光，然後突然被吸入次元裂縫。

scripts.text: I thought I was just seeing things, but it's obvious now that it really happened.
scripts.translation: 我以為自己看花了眼，但現在很明顯，那確實發生了。

scripts.text: You were actually in the past for a little while there.
scripts.translation: 你剛才真的在過去待了一會兒。

scripts.text: I'm afraid this space gap hides bigger secrets than we thought.
scripts.translation: 恐怕這個次元裂縫隱藏著比我們想像中更多的秘密。

scripts.text: ..It not only warps space, but also time ...
scripts.translation: ......它不只扭曲空間，也會扭曲時間......

scripts.text: Forget it. I was just thinking out loud.
From now on, we should be extra careful about letting anything into this space gap. I need to report this incident to upper management.
scripts.translation: 從現在開始，我們得格外小心，別讓任何東西進入次元裂縫。我需要向高層彙報這件事。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but can you ask a scholar about this spell scroll?
scripts.translation: 抱歉，你能去問問學者這張魔法卷軸的事嗎？

scripts.text: If you don't know which scholar you should consult, then you'd better ^4d4dffask Echinacea^000000
scripts.translation: 如果不知道該問誰，最好去請^4d4dff教紫錐菊^000000。

scripts.text: Did you find a scholar to ask about the scroll?
scripts.translation: 你找到學者詢問卷軸的事了嗎？

scripts.text: If you don't know which scholar to consult, then you'd better ask Echinacea.
scripts.translation: 如果你不知道該諮詢哪位學者，最好去問問紫錐菊。

scripts.text: So this scroll is from Arunafeltz, huh?
scripts.translation: 所以這張卷軸來自阿魯納菲茲，是嗎？

scripts.text: Is that why you're gathering items to unseal the scroll?
scripts.translation: 這就是你在收集解除卷軸封印所需物品的原因？

scripts.text: - Let's bring Defaria the items to unseal the spell scroll. -
scripts.translation: - 我們把解除魔法卷軸封印的物品帶給德法里亞吧。 -

scripts.text: Keep up the good work, adventurer.
This must be the spell scroll, huh?
scripts.translation: 這一定就是那張魔法卷軸吧？
裡面有一種瞬間移動法術，

scripts.text: that will send the user to a specific location.. Hmm...
scripts.translation: 會把使用者傳送到特定地點......嗯......

scripts.text: You said you've heard Rayan ordering others to come to a certain place.
scripts.translation: 你說聽到拉揚命令同夥去某個地方。

scripts.text: If the spell of this scroll leads to that place..
scripts.translation: 如果這張卷軸會把人傳到那裡......

scripts.text: Then again.. Somebody will have to go there eventually..
scripts.translation: 不過......遲早會有人得去那裡......

scripts.text: Why are you looking at me?!
.Alright, then. Would you rather capture reincarnations of Morocc and collect their remnants?
scripts.translation: 好吧。那麼，你願意改去捕捉魔王夢羅克的轉世體，

scripts.text: Scholars suspect the recent space-time phenomenon has been caused by the 'Bloody Crystals of the Darkness,'
scripts.translation: 並收集他們的殘骸嗎？學者們懷疑近期的時空現象是“黑暗的血色結晶體”造成的。

scripts.text: so they want to study the crystals, which they believe are remnants of the of Morocc's reincarnations.
scripts.translation: 他們認為這些結晶體是魔王夢羅克轉世體留下的，想要研究。

scripts.text: That sounds way more dangerous, doesn't it? Go check that place out instead.
scripts.translation: 聽起來那個更危險，不是嗎？還是去調查那個地方吧。

scripts.text: Both those missions are dangerous, but I think you'll be risking your life less by checking out that place.
scripts.translation: 這兩個任務都很危險，但我認為去調查那個地方風險會小一些。

scripts.text: Now, listen. Use the spell scroll to teleport there, and then investigate the area. Find some clues.
scripts.translation: 聽好了。用魔法卷軸傳送過去，然後調查那片區域，尋找線索。

scripts.text: Don't put yourself in danger, and retreat when things get too dangerous.
scripts.translation: 別讓自己身陷險境，情況危險就撤退。

scripts.text: By the time you come back,
we should have figured out the cause of the strange phenomenon near this space gap.
scripts.translation: 我們應該已經查明次元裂縫附近奇怪現象的原因。

scripts.text: We'll think about everything else after you come back, alright?
scripts.translation: 其他事情等你回來再商量，好嗎？

scripts.text: Where's the scroll? Did you use it?
That scroll contains a teleportation spell.
scripts.translation: 那張卷軸包含瞬間移動法術。

scripts.text: Using it will lead you to a place that has something to do with them.
scripts.translation: 使用它會把你帶到一個與他們有關的地方。

scripts.text: You're supposed to gather some clues once you're there.
scripts.translation: 你到了那裡應該收集一些線索。

scripts.text: ..I guess you haven't found any clues.
Do you remember the location of that place?
scripts.translation: 還記得那個地方在哪兒嗎？

scripts.text: Why don't you go it check out again?
Yes, there must be some sort of clue there.
That scroll contains a teleportation spell.
scripts.translation: 那張卷軸包含瞬間移動法術。

scripts.text: Using it will lead you to a place that has something to do with them.
scripts.translation: 使用它會把你帶到一個與他們有關的地方。

scripts.text: You're supposed to gather some clues once you're there.
scripts.translation: 到了那裡記得收集線索。

scripts.text: If you lost the scroll, I expect you to find that place at any cost.
scripts.translation: 如果你弄丟了卷軸，就無論如何也要找到那個地方。

scripts.text: What did you find over there?
- You interrupted Mr. Kidd, and told him what you heard from the basement in the empty house near the national border. -
scripts.translation: - 你打斷基德先生，把在國境附近那間空屋地下室聽到的話告訴了他。 -

scripts.text: And the location is.. Okay, I got it.
Can you go back and spy on them a bit more?
scripts.translation: 你能回去再監視他們一會兒嗎？

scripts.text: I'll follow you as soon as I report these findings to the higher-ups.
scripts.translation: 我向高層彙報這些發現後就去找你。

scripts.text: They must be having a serious internal dispute,
scripts.translation: 他們內部一定發生了嚴重爭執，

scripts.text: meaning it's the perfect time for us to raid them.
scripts.translation: 這正是我們突襲的好時機。

scripts.text: Keep monitoring them for me, alright?
scripts.translation: 繼續替我監視他們，好嗎？

scripts.text: He's locked up in the basement, and Rin is interrogating him.
scripts.translation: 他被關在地下室，琳恩正在審問他。

scripts.text: You know, she's the best interrogator we've got. There'll be no escape for that guy ..
scripts.translation: 她是我們最好的審訊官。那個傢伙別想逃......

scripts.text: ..Wait, what if the same thing happens..?
The crystal no longer resonates with the space gap.
scripts.translation: 這塊結晶體不再與次元裂縫共鳴了。

scripts.text: Now it's exactly the same as a regular Crystal of Darkness.
scripts.translation: 現在它和普通的黑暗結晶體完全一樣。

scripts.text: That means, the phenomenon that you've experienced with the 'Bloody Crystal of Darkness' can't be..
scripts.translation: 也就是說，你遇到的“黑暗的血色結晶體”現象無法......

scripts.text: ..I guess not. It might have resonated to your mana or wavelength.
scripts.translation: ......我想也是。它可能與你的瑪娜或波長產生了共鳴。

scripts.text: Why don't you carry it with you? Let me know if you experience any strange phenomenon again.
scripts.translation: 你不妨把它帶在身上。如果再遇到什麼奇怪的現象，告訴我一聲。

scripts.text: Oh, and please bring ^4d4dffthis journal to Rin^000000.
scripts.translation: 哦，還有，請^4d4dff把這本日誌帶給琳^000000恩。

scripts.text: This will be your last assignment from me.
scripts.translation: 這是我交給你的最後一個任務。

scripts.text: Why should I carry the crystal?
scripts.translation: 為什麼我要帶著結晶體？
這個最後的任務是什麼？

scripts.text: We're just using one journal to record each other's work.
scripts.translation: 我們只是用同一本日誌來記錄彼此的工作。

scripts.text: Why can't you use separate journals and then combine them later?
scripts.translation: 為什麼不能各用各的日誌，之後再合併呢？

scripts.text: Ask Echinacea. I'm just doing what the boss tells me to do.
scripts.translation: 去問紫錐菊吧。我只是照老闆的吩咐辦事。

scripts.text: Using one set journal is a good way to keep in contact and accumulate a history of work in chronological order.
scripts.translation: 共用一本日誌，能讓我們保持聯絡，並按時間順序記錄工作進展。

scripts.text: We came up with the idea to share our experiences
scripts.translation: 我們的想法是共享彼此的經歷，

scripts.text: and understand any relation between incidents
scripts.translation: 儘可能快速、輕鬆地弄清各個事件之間是否有關聯.

scripts.text: as quickly and easily as possible..
I know it's a little bit counterproductive, but I'm satisfied with the quality of information shared between us.
scripts.translation: 我知道這樣有點適得其反，不過我對彼此共享的資訊質量很滿意。

scripts.text: The notes that Rin has absent-mindedly written down can turn out to be great clues for me..
scripts.translation: 琳恩隨手記下的筆記，有時會成為很重要的線索......

scripts.text: Yeah, I agree that the journal looks pretty disorganized.
scripts.translation: 是的，我也覺得這本日誌看起來挺雜亂的。

scripts.text: Rayan has already been caught, so the task to locate him and Rin is already done.
scripts.translation: 拉揚已經被抓住，尋找他和琳恩的任務也結束了。

scripts.text: You were just an assistant to start with.
Anyways, please deliver the journal to her safely.
scripts.translation: 總之，請把日誌安全地交給她。

scripts.text: I'm still not done yet; Echinacea already has another task for me..
scripts.translation: 我還沒忙完呢，紫錐菊已經給我安排了另一個任務......

scripts.text: I asked you to deliver the journal to Rin.
scripts.translation: 我讓你把日誌交給琳恩。

scripts.text: You didn't forget it, did you?
By the way, I'm still not convinced that we've captured the real Rayan.
scripts.translation: 順便說一句，我仍不確定我們抓到的是真正的拉揚。

scripts.text: Will you tell Rin to write down the results of her interrogation in the journal?
scripts.translation: 你能讓琳恩把審訊結果記在日誌裡嗎？

scripts.text: Of course, I'm pretty sure she'll do it without me reminding her.
scripts.translation: 當然，我相信她不用我提醒也會記下來的。

scripts.text: You don't have to report everything to me.
I can check the journal later.
Why don't you go assist Rin for now?
..Things didn't turn out exactly as we hoped, but there's nothing we can do for now.
scripts.translation: ...事情並沒有完全按照我們的預期發展，但現在也無能為力了。

scripts.text: you've been of great help to us.
I told you that I won't have any more work available for you. Well, for a good while, anyway..
scripts.translation: 我告訴過你，暫時不會再給你安排工作了。至少這陣子不會......
德法里亞先生派我來的

scripts.text: ..I guess he's finally made a fire, huh?
Tell him thanks for these sweet potatoes.
scripts.translation: 替我謝謝他送來的紅薯。
詢問關於阿魯納菲茲的事

scripts.text: I'm indebted to them, but they all died before I had a chance to pay them back.
scripts.translation: 我欠他們人情，可他們都在我來得及報答之前去世了。

scripts.text: If you're asking about my political opinion, I'm not going to answer.
scripts.translation: 如果你是在問我的政治立場，我不會回答。

scripts.text: This isn't something with which I can interfere.
Let me tell you that, from their point of view; their one last chance was destroyed.
scripts.translation: 從他們的角度看，最後的機會被毀掉了。

scripts.text: They're probably too ashamed to even talk about it.
scripts.translation: 他們大概羞愧得連提都不敢提。

scripts.text: Let our diplomats use that fact to their advantage, alright?
scripts.translation: 讓我們的外交官利用這一點，好嗎？

scripts.text: No conflicts have arisen recently, either.
scripts.translation: 最近也沒有發生任何衝突。

scripts.text: Besides, nationality isn't important to us.
scripts.translation: 而且，國籍對我們來說並不重要。

scripts.text: What's important is whether or not they're our enemies, and whether or not they're the target of our missions.
scripts.translation: 重要的是他們是不是敵人，以及是不是我們的任務目標。

scripts.text: Err? I don't have two Nice Sweet Potatoes..
scripts.translation: 咦？我沒有兩個美味紅薯......

scripts.text: A mission is just a mission.
Don't get too emotional or curious about it.
scripts.translation: 別太感情用事，也別太好奇。

scripts.text: ...You'd better not approach the space gap off the official route.
scripts.translation: ......你最好別擅自離開正式路線，靠近次元裂縫。

scripts.text: If you're not authorized, then turn away. This thing is too dangerous for capricious exploration.
scripts.translation: 沒有得到許可就離開那裡。這東西太危險，不適合隨意探索。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 攜帶物品過多時，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text: I'm experiencing a turning point in my life right now.
scripts.translation: 我現在正處於人生的轉折點。

scripts.text: - The fire sparked, but then it immediatly blew out. -
scripts.translation: - 火苗剛剛點燃，隨即就熄滅了。 -

scripts.text: You know, that was my ninety-third attempt to make a fire with wet firewood.
scripts.translation: 你知道嗎，這是我第九十三次嘗試用溼柴生火。

scripts.text: Wait, was that the ninty fourth ot ninety fifth?
scripts.translation: 等等，是第九十四次還是第九十五次？

scripts.text: I'm experiencing a turning point in my life right now.
scripts.translation: 我現在正處於人生的轉折點。

scripts.text: - The fire sparked, but then it immediately blew out.-
scripts.translation: - 火苗剛剛點燃，隨即就熄滅了。 -

scripts.text: to make fun of my stupid attempt to roast these sweet potatoes with wet firewood?
scripts.translation: 嘲笑我用溼柴烤紅薯的愚蠢嘗試嗎？

scripts.text: A spell scroll? May I see?
scripts.translation: 法術卷軸？能讓我看看嗎？

scripts.text: Eek... So Echinacea referred you to me, huh?
scripts.translation: 哎呀......所以是紫錐菊讓你來找我的？

scripts.text: As you can see, this scroll is sealed.
scripts.translation: 正如你所見，這張卷軸被封印了。

scripts.text: It can only be unsealed by a secret method.
scripts.translation: 必須用一種秘密方法才能解除封印。

scripts.text: The way it's sealed is the same method used by the temple...
scripts.translation: 它的封印方式和神殿使用的方法相同......

scripts.text: I don't know how you've gotten this scroll,
scripts.translation: 我不知道你是怎麼得到這張卷軸的，

scripts.text: ...but I'll try to help you on behalf of the respectable scholars of Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation: ......但我會代表阿魯納菲茲的學者盡力幫助你。

scripts.text: But remember; I'm not doing this officially. Please don't make me disgrace my country by helping you. Do you understand what I'm saying?
scripts.translation: 但請記住，我不是在履行官方職責。別讓我因為幫你而辱沒國家。明白我的意思嗎？

scripts.text: Good. Then I expect you to help me by gathering the items I need to unseal the scroll:
scripts.translation: 很好。那就請你幫我收集解除卷軸封印所需的物品：

scripts.text: ^4d4dff30 Holy Waters, Runes of Darkness, and Bloody Runes^000000.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff聖水30份、黑暗符文和血色符^000000文。

scripts.text: I'll be waiting for your return.
At first, you looked like someone who is reliable and understands the difference between official and private matters.
scripts.translation: 起初，你看起來可靠，也懂得區分公事與私事。

scripts.text: Your answer just proved me wrong.
scripts.translation: 你的回答證明我看錯了。

scripts.text: Echinacea must be getting desperate if she's asking people like you for help.
scripts.translation: 紫錐菊一定是走投無路了，才會找你這樣的人幫忙。

scripts.text: Good, it wasn't hard, was it?
Okay, can you come back in a little bit?

scripts.translation: 解除卷軸封印需要聖水30份、

scripts.text: I need ^4d4dff30 Holy Waters, Runes of the Darkness, and Bloody Runes^000000.
Don't forget to bring the spell scroll along with them.
scripts.translation: 別忘了把魔法卷軸也帶來。

scripts.text: While you're gathering the items, I'll be roasting my sweet potatoes.
scripts.translation: 你收集物品的時候，我會繼續烤紅薯。

scripts.text: If I could only make this fire work...
scripts.translation: 要是我能把這火生起來就好了......

scripts.text: Welcome back; you came at the perfect time.
scripts.translation: 歡迎回來，你來得正是時候。

scripts.text: First, this spell scroll contains a teleportation spell.
scripts.translation: 首先，這張魔法卷軸裡包含一個瞬間移動法術。

scripts.text: You know what teleportation is, don't you?
scripts.translation: 你知道什麼是瞬間移動吧？

scripts.text: it's a spell that instantly moves you to a different location.
scripts.translation: 種能瞬間將你移動到別處的法術。

scripts.text: That's the spell contained in this scroll.
scripts.translation: 這張卷軸裡包含的就是這種法術。

scripts.text: This scroll will teleport you to a specific location.
scripts.translation: 這張卷軸會把你傳送到特定地點。

scripts.text: Such scrolls are generally used by ^4d4dfforganizations to gather their members^000000.
scripts.translation: 這類卷軸通常^4d4dff由組織用來召整合員^000000。

scripts.text: I don't know where this scroll will lead you..
scripts.translation: 我不知道這張卷軸會把你傳送到哪裡......

scripts.text: You'll be the one using this scroll. Am I right?
scripts.translation: 畢竟要用卷軸的是你，對吧？
.對了！我記得拉揚提到過要在某個地方集合！

scripts.text: So this scroll will take me to that meeting?
scripts.translation: 所以這張卷軸會帶我去那裡嗎？

scripts.text: Um, do you mind? Would you stop talking to yourself and just leave already?
scripts.translation: 呃，你介意嗎？別再自言自語了，趕緊離開吧。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but this old man needs some rest, alright?
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我這把老骨頭需要休息，好嗎？

scripts.text: What are you so worried about?
You'll see how it works as soon as you use it.
scripts.translation: 一用就知道它怎麼運作了。

scripts.text: ..I know they're involved in this case, but
Just tell me what you know.
Why should I go through all that trouble?
You can go and ask Echinaea.
This old man needs some rest, alright?
scripts.translation: 我這把老骨頭得休息了，好嗎？

scripts.text: What th--! How dare you fool an old man!
scripts.translation: 什麼——！你竟敢戲弄一個老人！

scripts.text: but I'm a representative of great Arunafeltz's scholars!
scripts.translation: 但我可是阿魯納菲茲大學者的代表！

scripts.text: It's a mistake to trifle with me like that!
scripts.translation: 這樣戲弄我可是大錯特錯！

scripts.text: Did you think I'm stupid just because I was trying to make a fire with wet firewood?!
scripts.translation: 你以為我用溼柴生火就是傻瓜嗎？！

scripts.text: ..*Pant Pant*.. Phew, even yelling tires me out..
scripts.translation: ......*氣喘吁吁*......呼，連吼幾句都累壞我了......

scripts.text: ...Umm... Can you bring me some Logs?
...And some sweet potatoes too, if you don't mind.
I need sweet potatoes for me, Mr. Kidd, and Echi... Umm...
scripts.translation: 我要給自己、基德先生和紫錐菊準備紅薯......嗯......

scripts.text: Please bring me ^4d4dff20 Sweet Potatoes and 30 Logs^000000.
I'll be waiting for your return.
You seem to give up really easily.
I don't blame you. Sometimes giving up is the best decision,
scripts.translation: 我不怪你。有時候放棄是最好的決定，

scripts.text: not to mention that it takes a certain kind of courage.
For example, Tarous that know when to abandon their hopes of getting cheese, you know, the bait in traps, are the hardest ones to catch. You know?
scripts.translation: 比如那些知道何時放棄乳酪的塔羅斯——你懂的，就是陷阱裡的誘餌。它們反而最難抓。明白嗎？
是的，我來自阿魯納菲茲......

scripts.text: Be more specific about your question,
scripts.translation: 把你的問題說得更具體一點，

scripts.text: Oh, you've really brought what I wanted!
scripts.translation: 哦，你真的把我要的東西帶來了！

scripts.text: No, wait, can you pile them on the firewood over there?
scripts.translation: 不，等等，能把它們堆在那邊的柴火上嗎？

scripts.text: Make it a nice, neat pile, please.
Oh, you forgot to put the sweet potatoes on top.
scripts.translation: 哦，別忘了把紅薯放在上面。

scripts.text: Hopefully I can make a fire with your nice logs....
scripts.translation: 希望我能用你帶來的好木柴生起火......

scripts.text: Oh, this is as great as I'd hoped!
scripts.translation: 哦，這比我預想的還要好！

scripts.text: I guess my magic hasn't gotten that rusty after all..
scripts.translation: 看來我的魔法並沒有那麼生疏......

scripts.text: If you want me to do you a favor, then
you should bring me ^4d4dff20 Sweet Potatoes and 30 Logs^000000 in return.
scripts.translation: 就帶紅薯2^4d4dff0個、原木30根來^000000作為回報。

scripts.text: - Defaria is blowing on a roast sweet potato, peeling off it's skin. -
scripts.translation: - 德法里亞正對著烤紅薯吹氣，並剝去它的皮。 -

scripts.text: ... Dandelion? I wanted you to tell me what you knew.
scripts.translation: ......蒲公英？我想讓你告訴我你知道的事。

scripts.text: I was hoping you'd remember something about Dandelion.
scripts.translation: 希望你還記得一些關於蒲公英的事。

scripts.text: do you want me to confirm
if Dandelion is really supported by Arunafeltz?
scripts.translation: 你想讓我確認蒲公英是否真的得到阿魯納菲茲的支援嗎？

scripts.text: Umm... I don't know what to say... I don't feel comfortable talking about politics.
scripts.translation: 呃......我不知道該說什麼......我不太想談政治。

scripts.text: ...Do you mind delivering these to Mr. Kidd?
scripts.translation: ......能請你把這些交給基德先生嗎？

scripts.text: - Defaria has given you 2 Nice Sweet Potatoes. -
scripts.translation: - 德法里亞給了你2個美味紅薯。 -

scripts.text: Um, I just told you to deliver those sweet potatoes to Mr. Kidd.
scripts.translation: 呃，我剛剛才讓你把那些紅薯交給基德先生。

scripts.text: There are many different types of people in this world.
scripts.translation: 這個世界上有各種各樣的人。

scripts.text: Some people want war while others are against it.
scripts.translation: 有些人想要戰爭，有些人則反對。

scripts.text: The Dandelions were the former case.
Those right-ists believed in a distorted patriotism. They thought shedding blood was the only way to make peace.
scripts.translation: 那些右翼分子信奉扭曲的愛國主義，認為只有流血才能換來和平。

scripts.text: and they happened to ally themselves with the warmongers in the government.
scripts.translation: 並與政府中的戰爭狂熱者結成了同盟。

scripts.text: That's how they grew so strong.
scripts.translation: 他們就是這樣壯大起來的。

scripts.text: At first, their purpose was limited to gathering intel and spying on other countries.
scripts.translation: 起初，他們只負責蒐集情報、監視他國。

scripts.text: This is just what I think, but the right information can cause chaos in a country.
scripts.translation: 這只是我的看法，不過，準確的情報也能讓一國陷入混亂。

scripts.text: Can't you see it by now? Isn't it obvious?
Well, if you can't take care of your own problems,
scripts.translation: 這不是很明顯嗎？好吧，如果你連自己的問題都解決不了，

scripts.text: then you won't be able to handle your enemies.

scripts.translation: 所以是阿魯納菲茲策劃了這一切！

scripts.text: No, it isn't that simple. The world isn't just black and white, you know?
scripts.translation: 不，事情沒那麼簡單。世界不是非黑即白的，你知道嗎？

scripts.text: Just bring these to Echinacea, will you?
scripts.translation: 把這些交給紫錐菊，好嗎？

scripts.text: - You have received 2 steaming hot Nice Sweet Potatoes. -
scripts.translation: - 你收到2個熱氣騰騰的美味紅薯。 -

scripts.text: I told you to deliver those cooked sweet potatoes to Echinacea.
scripts.translation: 我讓你把烤好的紅薯交給紫錐菊。
紫錐菊真的那麼說了嗎？

scripts.text: She's an executive of the Rune-Midgarts army.
scripts.translation: 她是盧恩·米德加爾特軍隊的高階官員。

scripts.text: I can tell that what she said came from the bottom of her heart.
scripts.translation: 我能聽出來，她說的話是發自內心的。

scripts.text: I'm relieved that things turned out this way.
scripts.translation: 事情能這樣收場，我就放心了。

scripts.text: After all, they're the reason why the three countries decided to cooperate.
scripts.translation: 畢竟，正是因為他們，三國才決定合作。

scripts.text: Of course, it's too early to say if the cooperation will last long.
scripts.translation: 當然，現在說合作能維持多久還為時尚早。

scripts.text: I just hope that the three countries will use this chance to form lasting, friendly relationships. Wouldn't that be great for the sake of everyone in the world?
scripts.translation: 我只希望三國能借此機會建立長久友好的關係。這對全世界的人不都是好事嗎？

scripts.text: Hrrm, but I'm not holding my breath for world peace.
scripts.translation: 唉，不過我可不指望世界和平。

scripts.text: I'm just a mere human who can't foresee the future, you know?
scripts.translation: 我只是個無法預見未來的普通人，你知道嗎？

scripts.text: Ah, your sweet potatoes are now roasted very well.
scripts.translation: 啊，你的紅薯已經烤好了。

scripts.text: Thank you for trying so hard to please this whimsical old man.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你這麼努力地討好我這個古怪的老人。

scripts.text: - Defaria is lost in thought, standing with a poker in one hand
scripts.translation: - 德法里亞若有所思地站著，一手拿著火鉗，

scripts.text: and a sweet potato in the other. -
- Sometimes, he looks to the sky, sighs, and then says, 'I'm envious of young people these days ..'
scripts.translation: - 有時，他會仰望天空、嘆氣，然後說：“真羨慕現在的年輕人......” -

scripts.text: or something like 'I don't care anymore, no matter what happens.' -
scripts.translation: - 或者說“無論發生什麼，我都不在乎”之類的話。 -

scripts.text: - It sounds like he's having some pretty deep moments, so let's not disturb him. -
scripts.translation: - 聽起來他正沉浸在深思中，還是別打擾他了。 -

scripts.text: Please leave me alone unless you have extremely important business with me.
scripts.translation: 除非有非常重要的事，否則請別打擾我。

scripts.text: I have so many things that I want to do...
You've found some half-burnt logs of high quality.
scripts.translation: 你找到了一些燒了一半的上等木柴。

scripts.text: It seems somebody already roasted sweet potatoes with these logs.
scripts.translation: 看起來有人用這些木柴烤過紅薯。

scripts.text: You've found camp firewood that is too wet to make a fire.
scripts.translation: 你找到了一些溼得無法生火的營地木柴。

scripts.text: It seems somebody has been futilely attempting to make a fire with them.
scripts.translation: 看起來有人曾徒勞地試圖用它們生火。

scripts.text: Almost half of this town has been destroyed,
scripts.translation: 這座城鎮幾乎有一半被摧毀了，

scripts.text: and yet some people still come to visit.
I must say that it's amazing that our stronghold is still intact, and withstood all the devastation.
scripts.translation: 不得不說，我們的據點依然完好無損，經受住了所有破壞，真令人驚歎。

scripts.text: As you see, half of this town is gone. I guess there's no real reason to control access to this tavern.
scripts.translation: 正如你所見，這座城鎮的一半已經毀了。我想沒有必要再限制進入這家酒館。

scripts.text: Just feel free to go in.
I'm impressed by your courage to step into this hell.
scripts.translation: 我佩服你竟有勇氣踏進這片地獄。

scripts.text: Oh, not everyone can enter that place...!
scripts.translation: 哦，不是所有人都能進入那個地方......！

scripts.text: just feel free to enter wherever you want!

scripts.translation: 你現在帶的東西太多了。

scripts.text: to store some of your items.^000000
What would you like to drink?
Which one would you like to drink?
Are you sure you can even hold a glass of alcohol?
scripts.translation: 你確定自己能拿穩酒杯嗎？

scripts.text: You're carrying too many things on you already.
scripts.translation: 你身上已經帶了太多東西。

scripts.text: I can give you a special discount, but
you don't have enough money to even pay the special price.
scripts.translation: 但你的錢連折後價都付不起。

scripts.text: Why don't you check your money first?
This drink is only 800 zeny for Assassins!
I'll give you a special discount.
This drink is mainly made of fruit juice,
but you still shouldn't drink too much.
Do you even have any money?
Why don't you check your money first?
scripts.translation: 先看看自己有多少錢吧。

scripts.text: This drink is mainly made of fruit juice,
scripts.translation: 這杯飲料主要是果汁調的，

scripts.text: but you still shouldn't drink too much.
Are you sure you can even hold a glass of alcohol?
scripts.translation: 你確定自己能拿穩酒杯嗎？

scripts.text: You're carrying too many things on you already.
scripts.translation: 你身上已經帶了太多東西。

scripts.text: I can give you a special discount, but
you don't have enough money to even pay the special price.
scripts.translation: 但你的錢連折後價都付不起。

scripts.text: Why don't you check your money first?
This drink is only 800 zeny for Assassins!
I'll give you a special discount.
Do you even have any money?
Why don't you check your money first?
scripts.translation: 先看看自己有多少錢吧。

scripts.text: ...Rin? I see. So you're assisting Mr. Kidd.
scripts.translation: ......琳恩？原來如此，你是來協助基德先生的。

scripts.text: She was gravely injured not that long ago...
You can't expect your job to always go smoothly.
scripts.translation: 你不能指望工作總是順順利利的，

scripts.text: Of course there will be risks.
Why don't you go pay her a visit?
Rin needs to rest for now. I hope you'll do what you can to help her out.
scripts.translation: 琳恩現在需要休息。希望你能盡力幫她一把。

scripts.text: But please do take care of yourself as well.
You and Rin are like my children to me, and such injuries...
scripts.translation: 你和琳恩對我來說就像自己的孩子。看到你們受這樣的傷......

scripts.text: Sigh...it's torture for me to see.
I hope you'll come by more often. This place is open to you always, even if you don't have missions.
scripts.translation: 希望你以後能常來。即使沒有任務，這裡也永遠對你敞開大門。

scripts.text: Rin needs to rest in bed for a while. I hope you'll help her complete her duties.
scripts.translation: 琳恩需要臥床休息一陣子。希望你能幫她完成工作。

scripts.text: ...This is quite embarrassing to admit, but I see her like my own daughter.
scripts.translation: ......說出來有些不好意思，不過我把她當成自己的女兒。

scripts.text: Ah, just forget what I said. That was out of line.
scripts.translation: 啊，忘了我剛才說的話吧。我說得有些過分了。

scripts.text: I guess I'm drunk after dealing with alcohol all day.
scripts.translation: 整天和酒打交道，我大概是喝醉了。

scripts.text: For your information, the 'recommendation' has lost its effect. You'd better go back.
scripts.translation: 順便告訴你，那個“推薦”已經失效了。你最好還是回去吧。

scripts.text: ...? Why are you looking for Rin?
I see. So you're a member of the Ash Vacuum expedition.
scripts.translation: 原來如此，你是阿什真空探險隊的成員。

scripts.text: Rin is in the inner room.
...She's been badly injured and is resting in bed. Don't do anything to shock her, alright?
scripts.translation: ......她受了重傷，正在臥床休息。別做讓她受驚的事，好嗎？

scripts.text: Only authorized personnel can enter the inner room.
scripts.translation: 只有獲准人員才能進入內室。

scripts.text: Hey Master, is it okay to let this guy in?
scripts.translation: 師父，讓這傢伙進去沒問題嗎？
在找一個叫瑪爾雅娜的人。
你怎麼知道她的名字？師父，

scripts.text: what do I do with this guy?
Hmm. I sense no ill intent

scripts.translation: 我感覺這位冒險者沒有惡意。

scripts.text: also heard a rumor that the

scripts.translation: 我也聽說普隆德拉教會不知

scripts.text: way to tell if this person
scripts.translation: 我們無法確認這個人是否

scripts.text: I'll let you in if you buy me
a drink. Besides, you can't risk making trouble here: this place
scripts.translation: 我就放你進去。再說，最好別在這裡惹事：
這裡到處都是致命的刺客。
冒險者，我喜歡你的作風.

scripts.text: on in. But don't you dare

scripts.translation: 但絕不準把這家酒吧的

scripts.text: If you really want to enter,
make sure you have the cash!
scripts.translation: 想進去的話，先準備好錢！

scripts.text: should I help you? Go away!
If you keep outsiders away from the entrance, every drink you drink today will be on the house.
scripts.translation: 如果你能把外人擋在門口，今天你喝的所有酒都算我的。

scripts.text: So keep up the good work.
That's my cue to get you outta here!
scripts.translation: 這就是讓我把你趕出去的訊號！

scripts.text: What, haven't you seen a Knight before?
You think Knights don't belong here?
scripts.translation: 你覺得騎士不該待在這裡？

scripts.text: Looks like this is a case of the pot calling the kettle black.
scripts.translation: 這可真是五十步笑百步。

scripts.text: You know, I'm just here to take a break from the town restoration work.
scripts.translation: 我只是從城鎮重建工作中抽空來歇會兒。

scripts.text: There aren't many places that you can have a drink without being caught. You know?
scripts.translation: 能躲開別人、喝上一杯的地方可不多，你懂吧？

scripts.text: Say, how's it like outside? Meow?
I'm here to see you, Tao.
She's in the room on your left, meow~
But then, how d'you know she's here, meow?
scripts.translation: 不過，你怎麼知道她在這裡的，喵？

scripts.text: This is no place for playing, meow..
scripts.translation: 這裡可不是玩耍的地方，喵......

scripts.text: ... Hey, it's awkward you looking at me like that, meow..
scripts.translation: ......喂，你那樣盯著我，我很不自在，喵......

scripts.text: Tao knows what you're thinking, meow~ You're here to see big sister Rin, am I right, meow?
scripts.translation: 陶知道你在想什麼，喵～你是來找琳恩姐姐的，對吧，喵？

scripts.text: Hehe, where is she, I wonder, meow~
scripts.translation: 呵呵，不知道她在哪兒呢，喵～

scripts.text: If you don't have any reason to be here, you should leave, meow!
Not everyone can enter this place, meow.
Somehow you're here, but you can't go in the room.
scripts.translation: 雖然你進來了，但不能進房間。

scripts.text: No, wait... I think you may be able to go in... I don't know, meow!
scripts.translation: 不，等等......你也許能進去......我也不知道，喵！

scripts.text: Tao is tired of being a door keeper, meow! Meow!
Who are you calling a kid?
Tao is a good door keeper!
I can tell you've got some reason for being here, but you've put yourself in trouble!
scripts.translation: 我看得出你來這裡有原因，但你惹上麻煩了！

scripts.text: You're mistaken if you thought I would tell you
scripts.translation: 別以為我會告訴你師父和瑪爾雅娜在左邊的房間，

scripts.text: Master and Marjana are in the left room. Grrr.. Meow!
Are you making fun of me being a door keeper, meow?!
scripts.translation: 你是在嘲笑我看門嗎，喵？！

scripts.text: You make me mad, meow. Get lost!!
It's been a long time since I started meowing one day..
scripts.translation: 有一天我突然開始喵喵叫......

scripts.text: That day, Tao wanted to have a Big Ribbon so badly.
scripts.translation: 那天，陶特別想要一條大蝴蝶結。

scripts.text: So Tao went to find Wild Roses.
Meow?! Why am I telling you this, meow?!
scripts.translation: 喵？！我為什麼要告訴你這些，喵？！
啊，那個地方有防護魔法保護，
啊，那個地方有防護魔法保護，

scripts.text: Only authorized personnel can enter the inner room, meow!
scripts.translation: 只有獲准人員才能進入內室，喵！

scripts.text: What is it? I have nothing to ask you to do.
scripts.translation: 什麼事？我沒有要你做的事。

scripts.text: Could you please leave me alone? I have a bad headache.
scripts.translation: 請讓我安靜一會兒好嗎？我頭痛得厲害。

scripts.text: I'll ask you for a help some other time.
You look pretty passionate after all.
I'm really stressed out right now.
If you're here for the request that we made earlier, you can just forget about it.
scripts.translation: 如果你是來處理我之前委託的事，就忘了吧。

scripts.text: The room is also sealed with a security magic spell, meow.
scripts.translation: 房間也被防護魔法封住了，喵。

scripts.text: We already have a guest inside.
You can wait or come back later, meow.
scripts.translation: 你可以等等，或者稍後再來，喵。

scripts.text: The room is also sealed with a security magic spell, meow.
scripts.translation: 房間也被防護魔法封住了，喵。

scripts.text: We already have a guest inside.
You can wait or come back later, meow.
scripts.translation: 你可以等等，或者稍後再來，喵。

scripts.text: The room is also sealed with a security magic spell, meow.
scripts.translation: 房間也被防護魔法封住了，喵。

scripts.text: We already have a guest inside.
You can wait or come back later, meow.
scripts.translation: 你可以等等，或者稍後再來，喵。

scripts.text: This is the patient's room, meow.
Why don't you leave the patient alone to rest?
scripts.translation: 別打擾病人休息，出去吧。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 攜帶物品過多時，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text: It's been a long time. What's going on?
Who are you? Only authorized personnel can enter this area.
scripts.translation: 你是誰？只有獲准人員才能進入這個區域。

scripts.text: I haven't contacted him for a while, and so he's sent you to me...
scripts.translation: 我很久沒聯絡他了，所以他派你來找我......

scripts.text: As you see, I've been feeling under the weather. I'm in no condition to contact him.
scripts.translation: 你也看到了，我身體不太舒服，沒法聯絡他。

scripts.text: ...Let me think. Where I should start..?
I don't know if you know this, but something catastrophic happened in this town before Satan Morocc resurrected himself.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你是否聽說過，在魔王夢羅克復活之前，這個城鎮發生過一場災難。

scripts.text: R, otherwise known as 'Rayan,' performed a ritual to break Satan Morocc's seal.
scripts.translation: R，也就是“拉揚”，舉行儀式，企圖打破魔王夢羅克的封印。

scripts.text: We were able to gather a group of people and stop him from completing the ritual,
scripts.translation: 我們召集了一群人阻止他完成儀式。

scripts.text: and although the seal wasn't broken, he succeeded in weakening it.
scripts.translation: 封印雖然沒有被打破，但他還是成功削弱了它。

scripts.text: Soon after we captured him, an army of monsters attacked this town
scripts.translation: 我們抓住他後不久，魔物大軍就襲擊了城鎮，

scripts.text: as Satan Morocc's angry roars echoed in the air.
scripts.translation: 空中迴盪著魔王夢羅克憤怒的咆哮。

scripts.text: R, otherwise known as Rayan, is responsible for these series of events.
scripts.translation: R，也就是拉揚，是這一系列事件的罪魁禍首。

scripts.text: He caused everything that's happening now.
scripts.translation: 現在發生的一切都是他造成的。

scripts.text: I don't know if you know this, but something catastrophic happened in this town before Satan Morocc resurrected himself.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你是否聽說過，在魔王夢羅克復活之前，這個城鎮發生過一場災難。

scripts.text: R, otherwise known as 'Rayan,' performed a ritual to break Satan Morocc's seal.
scripts.translation: R，也就是“拉揚”，舉行儀式，企圖打破魔王夢羅克的封印。

scripts.text: We were able to gather a group of people and stop him from completing the ritual,
scripts.translation: 我們召集了一群人阻止他完成儀式。

scripts.text: and although the seal wasn't broken, he succeeded in weakening it.
scripts.translation: 封印雖然沒有被打破，但他還是成功削弱了它。

scripts.text: Soon after we captured him, an army of monsters attacked this town
scripts.translation: 就在我們抓住他後不久，一群魔物襲擊了這個城鎮，

scripts.text: as Satan Morocc's angry roars echoed in the air.
scripts.translation: 空氣中迴盪著魔王夢羅克憤怒的咆哮。

scripts.text: R, otherwise known as Rayan, is responsible for these series of events.
scripts.translation: R，也就是拉揚，是這一系列事件的罪魁禍首。

scripts.text: He caused everything that's happening now.
scripts.translation: 現在發生的一切都是他造成的。

scripts.text: Our job is primarily investigating Satan Morocc's whereabouts
scripts.translation: 我們的主要任務是調查魔王夢羅克的下落，

scripts.text: as well as the relation between the space gap and Satan Morocc...
scripts.translation: 以及次元裂縫與魔王夢羅克之間的關係......

scripts.text: We, however, couldn't let Rayan get away with what he's done
scripts.translation: 然而，我們不能讓拉揚對他所做的一切逍遙法外。

scripts.text: I've been focusing on pursuing Rayan.
scripts.translation: 我最近一直在全力追捕拉揚。

scripts.text: If we capture him, we might also find out some information about Satan Morocc:
scripts.translation: 如果我們能抓住他，也許還能打聽到魔王夢羅克的情報：

scripts.text: we might be able to learn where he tried to summon Satan Morocc, and where we should send Satan Morocc back to...
scripts.translation: 我們或許能得知他試圖在哪裡召喚魔王夢羅克，以及應該把魔王夢羅克送回哪裡......

scripts.text: I really want to know how the space gap is linked to Satan Morocc...
scripts.translation: 我真的很想知道次元裂縫與魔王夢羅克之間有什麼聯絡......

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I'm not yet fully recovered... I need to speak slowly. Please bear with me.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我還沒有完全康復......得慢慢說，請多包涵。

scripts.text: I received these injuries from Rayan and his gang. I finally located them after a long stakeout and pursuit...
scripts.translation: 這些傷是拉揚和他的同夥造成的。經過長時間的潛伏和追蹤，我終於找到了他們......

scripts.text: Yes... I need to write this down...
scripts.translation: 是的......我得把這些記下來......

scripts.text: - Mumbling something, she took down notes in an old notebook as she spoke. -
scripts.translation: - 她一邊低聲唸叨著，一邊在舊筆記本上做記錄。 -
蒲公英......他們是拉揚的傀儡。

scripts.text: I was ambushed by them in a mountain far from a village...
scripts.translation: 我在遠離村莊的一座山上遭到了他們的伏擊......

scripts.text: When I woke up, I was here.
scripts.translation: 醒來時，我發現自己就在這裡。

scripts.text: Since then, my vision's been blurry. I guess that must have been caused by my injuries...
scripts.translation: 從那以後，我的視力一直模糊。我想應該是受傷導致的......

scripts.text: How'd you like to conduct an investigation around that area? We might find something..
scripts.translation: 你願意去那片區域調查一下嗎？我們或許能找到什麼......

scripts.text: Like important clues or where they've headed...
scripts.translation: 比如重要線索，或者他們逃往的方向......

scripts.text: ^4d4dffIf you're interested in helping me, I'll continue talking.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff如果你願意幫我，我就繼續說下^000000去。

scripts.text: Did you just come by for no reason?
...God, I can't believe just let you come here!
scripts.translation: ......天哪，我真不敢相信他們就這樣讓你進來了！

scripts.text: Grr.. I need to teach them a lesson. Why can't they let me rest for God's sake!
scripts.translation: 哼......我得教訓他們一頓。看在老天的份上，就不能讓我好好休息嗎！

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I'm extremely tired and cranky.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我現在非常疲憊，脾氣也不太好。

scripts.text: If you don't have anything important to tell me, then I'd like you to leave.
scripts.translation: 如果沒有重要的事，請離開。

scripts.text: So, are you interested in helping me?
I remember the location was... Southwest from a village called Hugel.
scripts.translation: 我記得地點在......毀葛村的西南方。

scripts.text: Do you know where to find Abyss Lake, where the Dragons reside?.
scripts.translation: 你知道龍棲息的深淵湖在哪裡嗎？

scripts.text: ^4d4dffWhen you pass Abyss Lake and head west,^000000 you'll arrive at stiff mountains.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff穿過深淵湖向西走，就^000000會到達陡峭的山脈。

scripts.text: I was ambushed somewhere ^4d4dffsouth of the second hill from the top of the mountain^000000
scripts.translation: 我在從山頂往^4d4dff下數第二座山丘的南側遭到了伏^000000擊。

scripts.text: They ganged up on me, but I put up a good fight...
scripts.translation: 他們圍攻了我，但我奮力抵抗了......

scripts.text: I'm sure I at least made them drop something..
scripts.translation: 我肯定至少讓他們掉落了什麼東西。

scripts.text: Please try to find something there that might serve as a clue.
scripts.translation: 請去那裡找找，也許能找到線索。

scripts.text: While you're gone, I'll be preparing a document to send to Mr. Kidd.
scripts.translation: 趁你不在，我會準備一份檔案寄給基德先生。

scripts.text: Be safe, and look out for yourself, okay?
somewhere south of the second hill of a mountain west from Abyss Lake.
scripts.translation: 深淵湖以西的山脈中，第二座山丘的南側。

scripts.text: How do I remember the location so clearly?
scripts.translation: 我怎麼會記得這麼清楚？

scripts.text: It's the last location where I searched for Rayan. How can I not remember?
scripts.translation: 那是我最後一次搜查拉揚的地方，我當然記得。

scripts.text: Don't underestimate me; I'm an elite member of my guild.
scripts.translation: 別小看我，我可是公會的精英成員。

scripts.text: - You told her you couldn't find anything regarding their whereabouts,
scripts.translation: - 你告訴她沒找到他們行蹤的線索，

scripts.text: but you found the ''Bloody Crystal of Darkness'' in the bushes.
scripts.translation: 但在灌木叢裡發現了“黑暗的血色結晶體”。 -

scripts.text: You can feel the evil spirit just by looking at it.
scripts.translation: 光看一眼就能感受到它的邪惡氣息。

scripts.text: This...there's no doubt. It's the same kind of crystal as the ones found on Satan Morocc and his minions.
scripts.translation: 毫無疑問，這和魔王夢羅克及其爪牙身上的結晶體是同一種。
可是......這塊結晶體留在了那裡......

scripts.text: So it seems Rayan and Satan Morocc...there really is something going on between those two.
scripts.translation: 看來拉揚和魔王夢羅克......他們之間確實有某種聯絡。

scripts.text: Just lying here, not being able to do anything...it's so frustrating.
scripts.translation: ..只能躺在這裡，什麼都做不了......真讓人沮喪。

scripts.text: Here, take this journal to Mr. Kidd.
scripts.translation: 拿著，把這本日誌交給基德先生。

scripts.text: It should've been done a while ago.
Oh, bring this crystal to him as well.
scripts.translation: 哦，這塊結晶體也一併交給他。

scripts.text: Ah..the journal..Yes, I should record this incident onto the journal.
scripts.translation: 啊......日誌......是的，我應該把這次事件記在日誌裡。

scripts.text: Here's the journal and the crystal.
Take them to Mr. Kidd for me.
- You received the journal from Rin.
scripts.translation: - 你從琳恩那裡收到了日誌。

scripts.text: Instead of a journal, it's more like a bunch of documents being exchanged. -
scripts.translation: 與其說是日誌，不如說是一疊互相傳閱的檔案。 -

scripts.text: Can you show it to me?
Oh, I don't have it with me. I'll go bring it right away.
scripts.translation: 哦，我沒帶在身上。我馬上去拿。

scripts.text: ^4d4dff(Wait, what did I do with it? I didn't sell it or anything, did I?)^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff（等等，我把它放哪兒了？我沒賣掉吧^000000？）

scripts.text: Hurry up; deliver the journal and crystal to Mr. Kidd.
scripts.translation: 快點，把日誌和結晶體交給基德先生。

scripts.text: ..Argh.. I'm still recovering .. I'm not supposed to move~
- You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 攜帶物品過多時，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text: Hey, you've come back at just the right time.
Look at him; this is ridiculous.
I know what I did is unforgivable, no matter how good my reason might be.
scripts.translation: 我知道自己做的一切不可原諒，不管理由多麼正當。

scripts.text: ..But... *Sigh*... It's too late to regret it now, isn't it?
scripts.translation: ......可是......*嘆氣*......現在後悔也來不及了，不是嗎？

scripts.text: Don't you know? He's Rayan Moore who dared to release Satan Morocc, deceive everyone, and bring havoc to this world.
scripts.translation: 你不知道嗎？他就是拉揚·摩爾，那個膽敢釋放魔王夢羅克、欺騙眾人並給世界帶來浩劫的人。

scripts.text: Not only that, he slaughtered his own comrades without mercy!
scripts.translation: 不僅如此，他還毫不留情地屠殺了自己的同伴！

scripts.text: ..I.. I.. I killed them with my own hands!
He still hasn't gotten over the fact that he killed all of his comrades.-
scripts.translation: 他仍然無法接受自己殺死了所有同伴的事實。 -

scripts.text: He doesn't look like the Rayan I know.
scripts.translation: 他看起來不像我認識的那個拉揚。

scripts.text: I don't know. This Rayan seems to be a completely different individual than the one we know.
scripts.translation: 我不知道。這個拉揚似乎和我們認識的那個人完全不同。

scripts.text: I guess this is what they call Multiple Personality Disorder.
scripts.translation: 我想這就是所謂的多重人格障礙。

scripts.text: This Rayan isn't the Rayan Moore that plotted the conspiracy,
scripts.translation: 這個拉揚不是策劃陰謀的拉揚·摩爾，

scripts.text: but another personality hidden inside of him.
scripts.translation: 而是隱藏在他體內的另一個人格。

scripts.text: Hey, calm down. Why don't you speak slowly?
..It was me.. I was only going to pretend to break the seal of Satan Morocc...
scripts.translation: ......是我......我原本只是想假裝打破魔王夢羅克的封印......

scripts.text: Don't you see? I meant for it to just be an act! I was going to throw the town in panic...
scripts.translation: 你們不明白嗎？那只是演戲！我本想讓城鎮陷入恐慌......

scripts.text: ..That would be my chance to spread the teachings of Freya, our messiah.
scripts.translation: ......那樣我就有機會傳播我們救世主芙蕾雅的教義。

scripts.text: Man, how can you be so stupid?!
scripts.translation: 天哪，你怎麼能這麼愚蠢？！

scripts.text: I was studying some documents for my plan, and then I found something by accident.
scripts.translation: 我在研究計劃相關的檔案時，偶然發現了某樣東西。

scripts.text: That was when I became a completely different person.. *Sob*
scripts.translation: 就在那時，我變成了另一個人......*抽泣*

scripts.text: ..My plan.. It was like I wasn't myself anymore. I wanted to release Satan Morocc for real.
scripts.translation: ......我的計劃......我好像不再是自己了。我想真正釋放魔王夢羅克。

scripts.text: I kidnapped children.. Threatened my comrades.
scripts.translation: 我綁架了孩子......還威脅同伴。

scripts.text: ..I held the true ritual to break the seal and release Satan Morocc...
scripts.translation: ......我舉行了真正的儀式，要打破封印、釋放魔王夢羅克......

scripts.text: Wah.. My.. My head hurts.. This.. No, you can't.. Waaah!
- Suddenly Rayan started talking nonsense and then pulled his hair out in anguish.
scripts.translation: - 拉揚突然開始胡言亂語，痛苦地揪著自己的頭髮。

scripts.text: It seems as if he is trying to resist the evil personality within him. -
scripts.translation: 看起來他正在試圖抵抗體內的邪惡人格。 -

scripts.text: - Wanting to stop Rayan from going berserk, you smacked the back of his head with the journal. Rayan staggered and then fell to the ground. Nice job! -
scripts.translation: - 為了阻止拉揚發狂，你用日誌敲了他的後腦勺。拉揚踉蹌幾步，倒在地上。幹得好！ -

scripts.text: - Wanting to stop Rayan from going berserk, you sucker punched him in the 'ole bread basket. Rayan staggered and then fell to the ground...! -
scripts.translation: - 為了阻止拉揚發狂，你狠狠揍了他的肚子。拉揚踉蹌幾步，倒在地上......！ -

scripts.text: - Wanting to stop Rayan from going berserk, you slapped his face with the journal. Rayan staggered and then fell onto the ground. Wah! -
scripts.translation: - 為了阻止拉揚發狂，你用日誌扇了他的臉。拉揚踉蹌幾步，倒在地上。哇！ -

scripts.text: - By your sudden violent move, the Bloody Crystal of Darkness flew out of your jacket, and rolled on the ground toward Rayan. -
scripts.translation: - 你突然動手時，黑暗的血色結晶體從夾克裡飛出，滾到了拉揚身邊。 -
為什麼......這裡沒有次元裂縫啊......？

scripts.text: He's come.. My master has arrived!!
As you command, master. I'm here to serve you!
scripts.translation: 遵命，主人。我來為您效命！

scripts.text: I'll be back at full strength,
scripts.translation: 我會以完全的力量歸來，

scripts.text: and I'll pay you back for locking me in the darkness for hundreds of years!^000000
scripts.translation: 為被你們囚禁在黑暗中數百年一事向你們討^000000還！

scripts.text: Are you Rayan? Or are you someone else now?!
scripts.translation: 你是拉揚嗎？還是變成別人了？！

scripts.text: You're too late. My master has already departed!
scripts.translation: 太遲了。我的主人已經離開了！

scripts.text: You're too foolish to understand his great will.
scripts.translation: 你們太愚蠢了，無法理解他偉大的意志。

scripts.text: This is the last time you'll ever see me.
scripts.translation: 這是你最後一次見到我了。

scripts.text: I'm kind of busy right now.
..I've brought back the journal and something else..
..Er, sorry. I forgot to bring the journal! I'll be right back.
scripts.translation: ......呃，抱歉。我忘了帶日誌！我馬上回來。

scripts.text: You know, that voice.. Do you think it was Satan Morocc...?
scripts.translation: 你知道，那個聲音......你覺得那是魔王夢羅克嗎......？

scripts.text: B.ased on what the more normal Rayan has told us,
scripts.translation: 也許吧。根據那個比較清醒的拉揚所說，

scripts.text: it seems that another personality within him was forcibly created by Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation: 似乎是魔王夢羅克強行在他體內製造了另一個人格。

scripts.text: Satan Morocc must have chosen Rayan to break his seal.
scripts.translation: 魔王夢羅克一定是選中了拉揚來打破封印。

scripts.text: He's been controlling Rayan from deep inside his mind..
scripts.translation: 他一直在拉揚內心深處控制著他...

scripts.text: And... That Mad Rayan seems to have a connection with your Bloody Crystal of Darkness.
scripts.translation: 而且...那個瘋狂的拉揚似乎與你的黑暗的血色結晶體有某種聯絡。

scripts.text: I didn't see that side of Rayan until you came; he was very cooperative and feeble up until then.
scripts.translation: 在你來之前，我沒見過拉揚的另一面；此前他一直很配合，也很虛弱。

scripts.text: The original Rayan seemed to remember everything that happened while he was controlled by that mad personality..
scripts.translation: 原本的拉揚似乎記得在被那個瘋狂人格控制期間發生的一切...

scripts.text: He was in shock after learning that he's killed all his comrades with his own hand.
scripts.translation: 得知自己親手殺死了所有同伴後，他陷入了震驚。

scripts.text: He started acting differently once you approached him. I must record all of this in the journal.
scripts.translation: 當你靠近他時，他開始變得不一樣了。我必須把這些都記錄在日誌裡。

scripts.text: Right. He completely changed once he touched the crystal, as if he himself became Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation: 沒錯。當他觸碰到結晶體後，他完全變了，彷彿他自己變成了魔王夢羅克。

scripts.text: I've marked Rayan's body in case he ran away.
scripts.translation: 我在拉揚身上做了標記，以防他逃跑。

scripts.text: I'll give you the pattern number of his magic wavelength. Can you give the number to Echinacea?
scripts.translation: 我會給你他的魔法波長模式編號。你能把這個編號給紫錐菊嗎？

scripts.text: She'll take care of the rest.
Don't leave out even one character. Okay?
scripts.translation: 不要漏掉任何一個字元。好嗎？

scripts.text: Here, bring this journal with you.
Please don't forget the pattern number. Alright? Make sure that Echinacea gets it.
scripts.translation: 請別忘了模式編號。好嗎？一定要讓紫錐菊收到。

scripts.text: Report to Echinacea in the Ash Vacuum, and give her the pattern number.
scripts.translation: 去阿什真空向紫錐菊彙報，並把模式編號給她。

scripts.text: The pattern number is ^4d4dff[SDHF92F-SDF]^000000. Don't leave out even one character. Okay?
scripts.translation: 模式編號是 [S^4d4dffDHF92F-S^000000DF]。不要漏掉任何一個字元。好嗎？

scripts.text: Report to Echinacea in the Ash Vacuum, and give her the pattern number.
scripts.translation: 去阿什真空向紫錐菊彙報，並把模式編號給她。

scripts.text: The pattern number is ^4d4dff[VWNM94GVWN90]^000000. Don't leave out even one character. Okay?
scripts.translation: 模式編號是 [V^4d4dffWNM94GVW^000000N90]。不要漏掉任何一個字元。好嗎？

scripts.text: Report to Echinacea in the Ash Vacuum, and give her the pattern number.
scripts.translation: 去阿什真空向紫錐菊彙報，並把模式編號給她。

scripts.text: The pattern number is ^4d4dff[CM3-TRDFGHE0]^000000. Don't leave out even one character. Okay?
scripts.translation: 模式編號是 [C^4d4dffM3-TRDFG^000000HE0]。不要漏掉任何一個字元。好嗎？

scripts.text: Yes? Why are you back again?
Make sure you don't forget it again. The pattern number is...
scripts.translation: 這次可別再忘了。模式編號是...

scripts.text: ^4d4dff[{0}]^000000. Don't leave out even one character. Okay?
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff[]{0}。^000000不要漏掉任何一個字元。好嗎？

scripts.text: I need to take a break...
Ahhh~ I'm a sick person. I need to rest!
scripts.translation: 啊哈~ 我生病了，需要休息！

scripts.text: I don't want to do anything else~
Hurry up and go, don't bother me~
- For some reason, Rayan is shivering in fear. -
scripts.translation: - 不知為何，拉揚正瑟瑟發抖。 -

scripts.text: He's not being himself for some reason.
scripts.translation: 他不知為何變得不像他自己了。

scripts.text: I'm just glad that he's sane enough to speak to me.
scripts.translation: 還好他神智清醒，還能和我說話。

scripts.text: I don't know what's going on with him.
scripts.translation: 我不知道他到底怎麼了。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 攜帶物品過多時，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text: You have found a pile of dirt and deep tracks under thick bushes.
scripts.translation: 你在茂密的灌木叢下發現了一堆泥土和深深的痕跡。

scripts.text: There are deep footprints and spilled blood around the area.
scripts.translation: 周圍有深深的腳印和灑落的血跡。

scripts.text: Some desperate fighting definitely happened here.
scripts.translation: 這裡顯然發生過激烈的戰鬥。

scripts.text: There are some broken branches to the side of a set of footprints that look like they're skidding backwards...
scripts.translation: 在一串向後滑行的腳印旁，有一些折斷的樹枝...

scripts.text: Somebody must have been fallen down on the ground, or...
scripts.translation: 有人一定是摔倒在地的，或者...

scripts.text: I've been having a strange feeling around this area...
scripts.translation: 我在這附近一直有種奇怪的感覺...

scripts.text: It feels like faint mana.. ?!... Yes, I can barely see an aura.
scripts.translation: 感覺像是微弱的瑪娜...？！...是的，我隱約能看到靈氣。

scripts.text: Hmm.. This place must be where Rin fought with Rayan's gang.
scripts.translation: 嗯... 這裡應該是琳恩和拉揚的手下戰鬥的地方。

scripts.text: I don't see anything that looks important.
scripts.translation: 我沒看到什麼重要的東西。

scripts.text: As you took a careful look,
you notice something shining in the ground.
scripts.translation: 你注意到地面上有東西在閃閃發光。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffYou have found a 'Bloody Crystal of Darkness'.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff你發現了一個“黑暗的血色結晶體^000000”。

scripts.text: I don't think I'll find anything else here...
scripts.translation: 我覺得這裡不會再找到其他東西了...

scripts.text: There are traces of a battle here, including spilled blood.
scripts.translation: 這裡有戰鬥的痕跡，包括灑落的血跡。

scripts.text: There's also a pile of dirt that seems out of place.
scripts.translation: 還有一堆看起來格格不入的泥土。

scripts.text: There are traces of a battle here, and spilled blood.
scripts.translation: 這裡有戰鬥的痕跡，以及灑落的血跡。

scripts.text: You find many footprints on the ground.
scripts.translation: 你在地面上發現了許多腳印。

scripts.text: Considering all the blood on the ground, a battle must have occurred here fairly recently.
scripts.translation: 考慮到地上大量的血跡，這裡最近一定發生過戰鬥。

scripts.text: The footprints continue over the hill.
scripts.translation: 腳印一直延伸到山丘那邊。

scripts.text: Somebody left a mark under this small tree.
scripts.translation: 有人在這棵小樹下面留下了標記。

scripts.text: The mark is weathered and faded,
but it is an arrow pointing southwest.
scripts.translation: 但它是一個指向西南方的箭頭。

scripts.text: There's some scribbling on the tree,
but you can't decipher what it means.
scripts.translation: 但你無法辨認出它的含義。

scripts.text: A mysterious force is repelling you, and you're unable to push forward into this area.
scripts.translation: 一股神秘力量排斥著你，讓你無法繼續深入。

scripts.text: As soon as you touched the crystal,
you feel your body being pulled into the space gap.
scripts.translation: 就感覺身體被拉進了次元裂縫。

scripts.text: You remember Kidd's confused voice, screaming your name.
scripts.translation: 你還記得基德困惑地喊著你的名字。

scripts.text: By the way, where am I?
I can't see things.. I'm getting dizzy...
I can hear a crowd of people coming...
scripts.translation: 我聽到人群走來的聲音...

scripts.text: Argh! It's too dark to see...!
scripts.translation: 啊！太黑了，什麼都看不見...！

scripts.text: Shut up! It's creepy that you all look alike. Bring it on! I'm not afraid of you!
scripts.translation: 閉嘴！你們長得一模一樣，真讓人毛骨悚然。放馬過來，我才不怕你們！

scripts.text: I'm not going to let you run away again!
scripts.translation: 這次我不會再讓你們逃掉！

scripts.text: Why? Why is Rin here? Wait, where am I?
scripts.translation: 為什麼？琳恩為什麼會在這裡？等等，我在哪裡？

scripts.text: Argh.. I can't move at all...
Hah, how impressive! You run like a rabbit!
scripts.translation: 哈，真了不起！你跑得像只兔子！

scripts.text: I should have you killed you when I had the chance.
scripts.translation: 我早該有機會時就殺了你。

scripts.text: I didn't expect you to be so persistent...
That's what I wanted to say!
You played me like a chess piece,
and now I want to tear you apart in five pieces. Why don't you just shut up and surrender before I kill you?
scripts.translation: 現在我要把你撕成五塊。趁我動手殺你之前，乖乖投降吧！

scripts.text: Hah.. You still have no idea, huh? You already lost this game, lady.
scripts.translation: 哈...你還是不明白嗎？這場遊戲你已經輸了，女士。

scripts.text: I'm sorry that I have to do this.
scripts.translation: 很抱歉，我不得不這麼做。

scripts.text: You feel helpless: you can do nothing but watch her slowly get overpowered..
scripts.translation: 你感到無能為力，只能眼睜睜看著她漸漸落入下風...

scripts.text: Then, the pressure on your body suddenly dissipates.
scripts.translation: 就在這時，壓在你身上的力量突然消散。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 攜帶物品過多時，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text: You have found a laceration on the dead body;
scripts.translation: 你在屍體上發現一道裂傷；

scripts.text: he must have been killed by Rin.
scripts.translation: 他一定是被琳恩殺死的。

scripts.text: It's creepy to touch a corpse, but you have decided to check his pockets for any clues.
scripts.translation: 摸屍體雖然讓人毛骨悚然，但你決定檢查他的口袋，看看有沒有什麼線索。

scripts.text: It's creepy to touch a corpse, but you have decided to shake and turn the body
scripts.translation: 雖然摸屍體很可怕，你還是決定翻動屍體尋找線索。

scripts.text: A scroll flew out of the body's jacket pocket.
scripts.translation: 一張卷軸從屍體的夾克口袋裡飛了出來。

scripts.text: You're not sure what this scroll is for, but obviously it seems pretty important.
scripts.translation: 你不確定這張卷軸是做什麼用的，但顯然它看起來非常重要。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffYou have obtained a Sealed Magic Scroll.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff你獲得了一張封印魔法卷軸。

scripts.text: You have found a Dandelion Member who was killed by Rin.
scripts.translation: 你發現了一名被琳恩殺死的蒲公英成員。

scripts.text: It's just a corpse, but there seems to be something unnatural about it.
scripts.translation: 這只是一具屍體，但似乎有什麼不自然的地方。

scripts.text: Now's not the time to examine corpses.
scripts.translation: 現在不是檢查屍體的時候。

scripts.text: You better take care of your living enemies first!
scripts.translation: 你最好先處理活著的敵人！

scripts.text: - You find a side door that leads to the basement.
scripts.translation: - 你發現一扇通往地下室的側門。

scripts.text: A faint light is shining through the hinges.
There are people inside, talking loudly. -

scripts.translation: 我們做了你要求的一切，但是.

scripts.text: We did something that we shouldn't have.
All we wanted was just to shake up the town just a little bit,
scripts.translation: 拉揚！我們只是想讓城鎮稍微亂一陣子，

scripts.text: not summon Satan Morocc! The ritual failed like we first planned, but...
scripts.translation: 沒想召喚魔王夢羅克！儀式像原計劃那樣失敗了，可是...

scripts.text: That's right. It failed, but what happened? Satan Morocc resurrected himself.
scripts.translation: 沒錯。它失敗了，但結果呢？魔王夢羅克復活了。

scripts.text: He'll bring the end of this world.
scripts.translation: 他將帶來這個世界的終結。

scripts.text: We can't even go back to our country now!
scripts.translation: 我們現在甚至無法回到自己的國家！

scripts.text: ...We all knew that we would be disposed after we stopped being useful.. Just like pawns in a chess match.
scripts.translation: ...我們都知道，一旦失去利用價值就會被處理掉...就像棋子一樣。

scripts.text: What the hell's wrong with you?
Why, can't you still forget the Assassin?
scripts.translation: 怎麼，你還忘不了那個刺客嗎？

scripts.text: ...Hey, tell us. What should we do now?
Let me ask you one question.
...Did you... Did you really summon Satan Morocc?
scripts.translation: ...你...你真的召喚了魔王夢羅克嗎？

scripts.text: Did you really ask us to help you resurrect Satan Morocc?!
scripts.translation: 你真的叫我們幫你復活魔王夢羅克？！

scripts.text: If your silence means yes, I'm out!
scripts.translation: 如果你的沉默意味著是，那我走了！

scripts.text: I didn't know then, but I know now. I'm leaving!
scripts.translation: 我當時不知道，但現在我知道了。我要離開！

scripts.text: Thank you for following my lead so far.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你們一直聽從我的指揮。

scripts.text: But you're nothing but puppets of the goddess.. *Giggle Giggle*
scripts.translation: 但你們不過是女神的傀儡罷了。*咯咯笑 咯咯笑*

scripts.text: Hey, hey! What are you doing?!
- You hear loud thuds and thumping in the midst of their yelling and screaming.
scripts.translation: - 在他們的叫喊聲中，你聽到沉重的撞擊聲。

scripts.text: It sounds like they're having a serious dispute.-
scripts.translation: 聽起來他們正在發生激烈的爭執。-

scripts.text: I have no idea what they're talking about. Why are they fighting?
scripts.translation: 我完全不知道他們在說什麼。他們為什麼在打架？

scripts.text: You're too stupid to understand my master's great will...
scripts.translation: 你們太愚蠢，理解不了主人的偉大意志...

scripts.text: ...Oh, right. I completely forgot about 'it.' It's time to take it back.
scripts.translation: ...哦，對了。我差點忘了“它”。該把它拿回來了。
你們覺得呢？*咯咯笑 咯咯笑*

scripts.text: What the?! Does he know I'm here?!

scripts.translation: - 你使用了一張蝴蝶翅膀。-

scripts.text: - The side to the basement is open.
scripts.translation: - 通往地下室的小門開了。

scripts.text: You can enter if you want. -
You have decided to not enter the basement.
- This door seems to lead to the basement,
scripts.translation: - 這扇門似乎通往地下室，

scripts.text: A man covered in blood is standing at a corner with a mysterious grin.
scripts.translation: 一個渾身是血的男人站在角落裡，臉上帶著詭異的微笑。

scripts.text: I guess it was the right timing.
By the way, who is this guy?
scripts.translation: 順便問一下，這傢伙是誰？

scripts.text: He looks kind of.. He's insane, isn't he?
scripts.translation: 他看起來有點...他瘋了吧？

scripts.text: Woah! Where did you come from?
They're all dead.. I've killed them.
Hehehe, I just followed the will of my master.
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿，我只是聽從主人的意志。

scripts.text: What? Is this really the Rayan we've been chasing?
scripts.translation: 什麼？這真的是我們一直在追捕的拉揚嗎？

scripts.text: Right, you said Rayan was having a dispute with his buddies..
scripts.translation: 對了，你說拉揚和同夥起了爭執...

scripts.text: ...Ray... Rayan? That's my name? That's right...
Where am I? What's all this blood?!
scripts.translation: 我在哪？這些血是怎麼回事？！

scripts.text: ...Huh? Where am I? What happened to my friends?
scripts.translation: ...咦？我在哪？我的朋友們怎麼了？

scripts.text: ...I guess I was right. He really is Rayan Moore.
scripts.translation: ...看來我猜對了。他真的是拉揚·摩爾。

scripts.text: He seems... He seems really confused. Maybe even unstable.
scripts.translation: 他看起來...非常困惑，甚至可能精神不穩定。

scripts.text: Well, it's the perfect time to capture this guy before he can kill us.
scripts.translation: 趁他還沒殺我們，正好可以抓住他。

scripts.text: Rin will know if this is the real Rayan because I've never seen him without his mask..
scripts.translation: 琳恩能判斷他是不是真正的拉揚，因為我從沒見過他摘下面具...

scripts.text: I'll bring this guy to Rin so she can interrogate him.
scripts.translation: 我要把這傢伙帶給琳恩，讓她審問他。

scripts.text: I'll see you at the camp.
- You watched Mr. Kidd arrest the unconscious Rayan and take out a teleportation item. You decide to return to town. -
scripts.translation: - 你看著基德先生逮捕了昏迷的拉揚，並拿出了一件瞬間移動道具。你決定返回城鎮。 -

scripts.text: I live to serve my master!
scripts.translation: 我活著就是為了侍奉我的主人！

scripts.text: You find a horribly dismembered dead body.
scripts.translation: 你發現一具被肢解得慘不忍睹的屍體。

scripts.text: It is disgusting to decribe the status of the Corpse!.
You find a horribly disfigured corpse.
scripts.translation: 你發現一具面目全非的屍體。

scripts.text: that appears to have been crushed to death.
You find a terribly mutated corpse.
scripts.translation: 你發現了一具變異得可怕的屍體。

scripts.text: You find a terribly mutilated corpse.
scripts.translation: 你發現了一具被殘害得可怕的屍體。

scripts.text: You find a horribly disfigured corpse.
scripts.translation: 你發現了一具面目全非的屍體。
